title: Grijanje u Banjoj Luci moglo bi poskupjeti za 52 posto
Heating in Banja Luka could become 52 percent more expensive
body: Gradska toplana Eko toplane traži da cijena grijanja u Banjoj Luci poraste za 52 posto.
The city heating company Eko toplane is asking for the price of heating in Banja Luka to rise by 52 percent.
Kompanija od grada traži i dodatnih 12 miliona KM godišnje iz budžeta.
The company is also asking the city for an extra 12 million KM a year from the budget.
Bez toga, kako upozorava, sistem ne može stabilno raditi.
Without that, it warns, the system cannot work stably.
Kompanija kaže da su porasli troškovi drvne sječke, struje, transporta i održavanja mreže.
The company says that the costs of wood chips, electricity, transport and network maintenance have risen.
Od 2018. do 2026. godine troškovi su porasli za 86 posto, a cijena grijanja samo za 22 posto.
From 2018 to 2026 costs rose by 86 percent, but the price of heating only by 22 percent.
Mreža toplovoda je stara, pa su kvarovi česti i gubi se mnogo toplote.
The network of hot-water pipes is old, so breakdowns are frequent and a lot of heat is lost.
Ako ne bude dogovora, toplana bi mogla smanjiti temperaturu u stanovima na 20 stepeni.
If there is no agreement, the heating company could lower the temperature in flats to 20 degrees.
Grijanje nije bilo na dnevnom redu sjednice Skupštine grada 19. novembra.
Heating was not on the agenda of the City Assembly session on 19 November.
Predsjednik Skupštine Ljubo Ninković rekao je da će odbornici o tome raspravljati na posebnoj sjednici 4. decembra.
Assembly President Ljubo Ninković said that councillors would discuss it at a special session on 4 December.
Gradonačelnik Draško Stanivuković rekao je da će gradska uprava pripremiti potrebne dokumente.
Mayor Draško Stanivuković said that the city administration will prepare the necessary documents.
Toplana grije oko 20.000 korisnika, a stare cijene za sada ostaju iste.
The heating company serves about 20,000 users, and the old prices stay the same for now.

title: Wembanyama vodio San Antonio do pobjede nad Clippersima
Wembanyama led San Antonio to victory over the Clippers
body: Košarkaši San Antonija pobijedili su Los Angeles Clipperse rezultatom 124:112.
San Antonio's basketball players beat the Los Angeles Clippers 124:112.
Victor Wembanyama postigao je 32 poena i imao 11 skokova, iako je igrao s bolnim žuljem.
Victor Wembanyama scored 32 points and had 11 rebounds, although he played with a painful blister.
Na kraju utakmice šutirao je s rukama iznad obruča, a društvene mreže su poludjele.
At the end of the game he shot with his hands above the rim, and social media went wild.
Spursi su na početku zadnje četvrtine gubili, ali su onda napravili veliku prednost.
The Spurs were losing at the start of the last quarter, but then built a big lead.
San Antonio sada ima 13 pobjeda i 3 poraza i dijeli prvo mjesto na Zapadu s Lakersima.
San Antonio now has 13 wins and 3 losses and shares first place in the West with the Lakers.
Memphis je pobijedio Golden State 126:98, a Warriorsi su igrali bez Stephena Curryja.
Memphis beat Golden State 126:98, and the Warriors played without Stephen Curry.
Damian Lillard postigao je 33 poena u pobjedi Portlanda nad Milwaukeejem 124:114.
Damian Lillard scored 33 points in Portland's 124:114 win over Milwaukee.
Bio je to njegov prvi meč protiv Bucksa otkako je kod njih teško povrijedio Ahilovu tetivu.
It was his first game against the Bucks since he badly injured his Achilles tendon while playing for them.
Milwaukee je izgubio 12. utakmicu zaredom i ima najgori start u historiji kluba.
Milwaukee lost its 12th game in a row and has the worst start in the club's history.
Prvaci New York Knicksi pobijedili su Minnesotu 102:99.
The champions New York Knicks beat Minnesota 102:99.
LaMelo Ball je 9,9 sekundi prije kraja promašio trojku za izjednačenje.
LaMelo Ball missed a three-pointer for the equaliser 9.9 seconds before the end.

title: Milan prati Demirovića, Stuttgart traži 35 miliona eura
Milan is watching Demirović, Stuttgart wants 35 million euros
body: Italijanski novinar Nicolò Schira objavio je da Milan prati napadača Ermedina Demirovića.
Italian journalist Nicolò Schira reported that Milan is watching striker Ermedin Demirović.
Reprezentativac BiH sada igra za njemački Stuttgart.
The BiH international now plays for the German club Stuttgart.
Schira je napisao i da je Juventus želio Demirovića prije dvije godine.
Schira also wrote that Juventus wanted Demirović two years ago.
Milan se za njega zanimao već u ljeto 2024. godine, kada je igrao za Augsburg.
Milan was already interested in him in the summer of 2024, when he played for Augsburg.
Augsburg je tada tražio 25 miliona eura, a Milan je mislio da je dovoljno 18 miliona, pa je Demirović otišao u Stuttgart.
Augsburg asked for 25 million euros at the time, while Milan thought 18 million was enough, so Demirović went to Stuttgart.
Ovog ljeta Galatasaray je ponudio oko 15 miliona eura, ali je Stuttgart odbio ponudu.
This summer Galatasaray offered about 15 million euros, but Stuttgart rejected the offer.
Prema njemačkim medijima, Stuttgart bi ozbiljno razgovarao o prodaji tek za oko 35 miliona eura.
According to German media, Stuttgart would seriously discuss a sale only for about 35 million euros.
U septembru se pisalo da je Demirović visoko na listi želja trenera Milana Rubena Amorima za januar.
In September it was reported that Demirović is high on Milan coach Ruben Amorim's wish list for January.
Tada se otvara prelazni rok, kada klubovi mogu kupovati igrače.
That is when the transfer window opens, when clubs can buy players.
Demirović ima ugovor sa Stuttgartom do ljeta 2028. godine.
Demirović has a contract with Stuttgart until the summer of 2028.
Ako dođe do prelaska, to bi bio najveći transfer u njegovoj karijeri.
If the move happens, it would be the biggest transfer of his career.

title: BiH danas u podne saznaje rivala u baražu Lige nacija
BiH learns its Nations League playoff rival today at noon
body: Nogometna reprezentacija BiH danas u 12 sati saznaje protivnika u baražu za Ligu A.
The BiH national football team learns its opponent in the playoff for League A today at 12 o'clock.
Žrijeb za Ligu nacija održava se u sjedištu UEFA-e u Nyonu u Švicarskoj.
The Nations League draw is being held at UEFA headquarters in Nyon in Switzerland.
BiH je jedna od reprezentacija koje su bile druge u Ligi B, pa je u šeširu sa Slovenijom, Mađarskom i Irskom.
BiH is one of the teams that finished second in League B, so it is in the pot with Slovenia, Hungary and Ireland.
Rival će biti jedna od četiri reprezentacije: Danska, Hrvatska, Vels ili Srbija.
The rival will be one of four teams: Denmark, Croatia, Wales or Serbia.
Prva utakmica igra se 25. ili 27. marta 2027. godine u BiH.
The first match will be played on 25 or 27 March 2027 in BiH.
Revanš je 28. ili 30. marta u gostima, ali navijači BiH tada neće moći biti na stadionu.
The return match is on 28 or 30 March away from home, but BiH fans will not be able to be at the stadium then.
UEFA ih je kaznila zbog baklji na jednoj utakmici u Švedskoj.
UEFA punished them because of flares at a match in Sweden.
Ako je rezultat nakon dvije utakmice isti, igraju se produžeci i penali.
If the score is level after two matches, extra time and penalties are played.
Pobjednik će u sezoni 2028/29 igrati u Ligi A, a poraženi ostaje u Ligi B.
The winner will play in League A in the 2028/29 season, and the loser stays in League B.
Žrijeb će direktno prenositi BHT 1, a Klix.ba će pratiti događaj uživo.
BHT 1 will broadcast the draw live, and Klix.ba will cover the event live.

title: Danas kiša na jugu i zapadu, za vikend jak vjetar
Rain today in the south and west, strong wind at the weekend
body: U Hercegovini i zapadnoj Bosni danas se očekuje kiša, a na jugu će biti pretežno oblačno.
Rain is expected today in Herzegovina and western Bosnia, and in the south it will be mostly cloudy.
U ostalim krajevima moguć je slab pljusak, a ujutro magla u dolinama i uz rijeke.
In other areas a light shower is possible, and in the morning fog in valleys and along rivers.
Jutarnja temperatura bit će od 4 do 10, a dnevna od 12 do 18 stepeni.
Morning temperatures will be from 4 to 10, and daytime temperatures from 12 to 18 degrees.
Na sjeveru Bosne moglo bi biti toplo i do 20 stepeni.
In the north of Bosnia it could be as warm as 20 degrees.
U Sarajevu je umjereno oblačno, ujutro oko 7, a tokom dana oko 15 stepeni.
In Sarajevo it is moderately cloudy, around 7 degrees in the morning and about 15 during the day.
U subotu će padati kiša, a vjetar sa zapada povremeno će biti jak.
On Saturday it will rain, and the wind from the west will at times be strong.
U nedjelju će biti hladnije, a najviše kiše očekuje se u Hercegovini.
On Sunday it will be colder, and the most rain is expected in Herzegovina.
U ponedjeljak dolazi primjetno hladnije vrijeme, s dnevnom temperaturom od 2 do 8 stepeni.
On Monday noticeably colder weather arrives, with daytime temperatures from 2 to 8 degrees.
Na planinama bi mogao pasti i slab snijeg.
Light snow could also fall in the mountains.
Tokom dana padavine će prestati, a nebo će se razvedriti.
During the day the precipitation will stop and the sky will clear.
Prognozu je objavio Federalni hidrometeorološki zavod.
The forecast was published by the Federal Hydrometeorological Institute.

title: Trump poručio Evropljanima da ne troše novac na rat u Ukrajini
Trump told Europeans not to spend money on the war in Ukraine
body: Američki predsjednik Donald Trump u četvrtak je razgovarao s evropskim liderima koji podržavaju Ukrajinu.
US President Donald Trump spoke on Thursday with European leaders who support Ukraine.
Lideri su bili na sastanku Koalicije voljnih u Berlinu, a Trump ih je nazvao iz aviona.
The leaders were at a meeting of the Coalition of the Willing in Berlin, and Trump called them from his plane.
Vraćao se iz Kine, gdje se sastao s Vladimirom Putinom i Xi Jinpingom.
He was returning from China, where he had met Vladimir Putin and Xi Jinping.
Prema pisanju Politica, Trump je rekao da Evropa ne bi trebala bacati novac na borbu protiv Rusije.
According to Politico, Trump said that Europe should not throw money at the fight against Russia.
Kraj rata bi, kako je rekao, sačuvao i novac i ljudske živote.
Ending the war, he said, would save both money and human lives.
Trump je također rekao da Putin ozbiljno želi pregovarati o miru.
Trump also said that Putin seriously wants to negotiate peace.
Njegov zet Jared Kushner rekao je da je Putin sada spreman prihvatiti sigurnosne garancije za Ukrajinu slične članu 5 NATO-a.
His son-in-law Jared Kushner said that Putin is now ready to accept security guarantees for Ukraine similar to NATO's Article 5.
Taj član govori o zajedničkoj odbrani članica.
That article is about the joint defence of the members.
Ukrajinski predsjednik Volodimir Zelenski rekao je da nije siguran da svi isto razumiju član 5.
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said he is not sure that everyone understands Article 5 the same way.
Pitao je šta je s američkim vojnicima i dodao da bi Ukrajina rado imala američke baze.
He asked what about American soldiers and added that Ukraine would gladly have American bases.
Njemački kancelar Friedrich Merz rekao je da Evropa pomaže Ukrajini da bi došlo do mira, a ne da bi rat trajao duže.
German Chancellor Friedrich Merz said that Europe helps Ukraine so that peace can come, not so that the war lasts longer.
Poljski premijer Donald Tusk rekao je da Trumpove riječi primaju s velikim oprezom.
Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk said that they are receiving Trump's words with great caution.

title: New York Times kritikovan zbog teksta o iranskim branama
New York Times criticised over an article about Iranian dams
body: Američki list New York Times u ponedjeljak je objavio tekst o branama u Iranu.
The American newspaper New York Times published an article about dams in Iran on Monday.
Autorice su uporedile lokacije brana s mjestima koja su napadnuta u ratu SAD-a i Izraela protiv Irana.
The authors compared the locations of the dams with places that were attacked in the US and Israeli war against Iran.
Zaključile su da su neke brane možda dijelom građene za vojne potrebe.
They concluded that some dams may have been built partly for military needs.
Mnogi kritičari kažu da takav tekst opravdava napade na civilnu infrastrukturu.
Many critics say that such an article justifies attacks on civilian infrastructure.
Infrastruktura su objekti važni za život, kao što su ceste, mostovi i vodovodi.
Infrastructure means facilities that are important for life, such as roads, bridges and water systems.
Iransko udruženje za vodnu diplomatiju reklo je da blizina vojnih ciljeva ne dokazuje da brane služe vojsci.
The Iranian Water Diplomacy Association said that being close to military targets does not prove that the dams serve the army.
Neki stručnjaci koje list citira rekli su da se ne slažu s takvim tumačenjem.
Some experts quoted by the newspaper said they do not agree with such an interpretation.
Profesor Amir AghaKouchak rekao je da brane nikada ne smiju biti meta napada jer su važne za život ljudi.
Professor Amir AghaKouchak said that dams must never be the target of attacks because they are important for people's lives.
New York Times je u utorak odbranio tekst i rekao da se zasniva na istraživanju i izjavama sedam stručnjaka.
On Tuesday the New York Times defended the article and said it is based on research and statements from seven experts.
Kritike dolaze dok SAD prijeti novim vojnim napadima na Iran.
The criticism comes as the US threatens new military attacks on Iran.
Prema organizaciji HRANA, od početka rata 28. februara u Iranu je poginulo 3.684 ljudi.
According to the HRANA organisation, 3,684 people have been killed in Iran since the war began on 28 February.

title: Opera Narodnog pozorišta Sarajevo slavi 80 godina
The Opera of the National Theatre Sarajevo celebrates 80 years
body: Opera Narodnog pozorišta Sarajevo počela je slavlje 80. godišnjice velikim gala koncertom.
The Opera of the National Theatre Sarajevo began its 80th anniversary celebration with a big gala concert.
Sala je bila rasprodana, a publika je muzičare na kraju ispratila ovacijama.
The hall was sold out, and at the end the audience sent the musicians off with ovations.
Solisti i hor Opere nastupili su sa Sarajevskom filharmonijom, a dirigovao je maestro Dario Vučić.
The soloists and the Opera chorus performed with the Sarajevo Philharmonic, conducted by maestro Dario Vučić.
Na programu su bile poznate arije, dueti i horske numere.
The programme included well-known arias, duets and choral pieces.
Arija je pjesma koju u operi pjeva jedan pjevač.
An aria is a song that one singer sings in an opera.
Publika je čula djela Verdija, Puccinija, Rossinija, Bizeta i drugih velikih kompozitora.
The audience heard works by Verdi, Puccini, Rossini, Bizet and other great composers.
Izvedena su i djela bosanskohercegovačkih kompozitora Asima Horozića i Ammara Jažića.
Works by Bosnian-Herzegovinian composers Asim Horozić and Ammar Jažić were also performed.
Opera je počela redovno raditi 9. novembra 1946. godine.
The Opera began working regularly on 9 November 1946.
Prva predstava bila je opera „Prodana nevjesta“ češkog kompozitora Bedřicha Smetane.
The first performance was the opera "The Bartered Bride" by the Czech composer Bedřich Smetana.
Slavlje se nastavlja 30. novembra i 1. decembra, kada se na scenu vraća Puccinijeva „La bohème“.
The celebration continues on 30 November and 1 December, when Puccini's "La bohème" returns to the stage.

title: Urolog objašnjava četiri manje poznata znaka niskog testosterona
A urologist explains four lesser-known signs of low testosterone
body: Britanski list Metro pisao je o takozvanoj „muškoj menopauzi“, koja se veže za muškarce između 40 i 60 godina.
The British newspaper Metro wrote about so-called "male menopause", which is linked to men between 40 and 60.
Profesor urologije Tet Yap kaže da mnogi muškarci neke znakove pogrešno smatraju normalnim starenjem.
Urology professor Tet Yap says that many men wrongly see some signs as normal ageing.
Prema njegovim riječima, sam izraz nije medicinski tačan.
In his words, the term itself is not medically accurate.
Kod muškaraca testosteron obično polako opada, a mnogi nikada nemaju ozbiljan manjak tog hormona.
In men testosterone usually falls slowly, and many never have a serious lack of that hormone.
Prvi znak su slabije kosti, jer testosteron pomaže da kosti ostanu čvrste.
The first sign is weaker bones, because testosterone helps bones stay strong.
Drugi znak su valovi vrućine i noćno znojenje, koje većina ljudi veže samo za žene.
The second sign is hot flushes and night sweats, which most people link only with women.
Treći znak su promjene u seksualnom životu, a četvrti promjene u izgledu, kao što su tanja kosa i manje mišića.
The third sign is changes in sex life, and the fourth is changes in appearance, such as thinner hair and less muscle.
Yap upozorava da iste simptome mogu izazvati i stres, depresija, dijabetes ili alkohol.
Yap warns that the same symptoms can also be caused by stress, depression, diabetes or alcohol.
Zato se dijagnoza nikada ne bi trebala postaviti samo na osnovu liste simptoma.
That is why a diagnosis should never be made only on the basis of a list of symptoms.
Savjetuje muškarcima da ljekaru kažu i za male promjene koje primijete.
He advises men to tell a doctor even about small changes that they notice.
Rekao je da je izraz ipak koristan jer potiče muškarce da govore o svom zdravlju.
He said that the term is still useful because it encourages men to talk about their health.

title: Anthropic na berzi prikupio rekordnih 81,3 milijarde dolara
Anthropic raised a record 81.3 billion dollars on the stock exchange
body: Kompanija Anthropic, koja pravi AI asistenta Claude, danas je počela trgovati na berzi Nasdaq u New Yorku.
The company Anthropic, which makes the AI assistant Claude, began trading on the Nasdaq stock exchange in New York today.
Prodajom dionica prikupila je 81,3 milijarde dolara, što je najveći iznos u historiji.
By selling shares it raised 81.3 billion dollars, the largest amount in history.
Tako je srušila rekord SpaceX-a, koji je u junu prikupio 75 milijardi dolara.
It thus broke the record of SpaceX, which raised 75 billion dollars in June.
Cijena dionice bila je 83 dolara, a prva trgovina je otvorena na 111,50 dolara.
The share price was 83 dollars, and the first trade opened at 111.50 dollars.
To je 34 posto više od početne cijene.
That is 34 percent more than the starting price.
Nakon nekoliko minuta cijena je pala na 101,24 dolara, ali je i dalje bila visoka.
After a few minutes the price fell to 101.24 dollars, but it was still high.
Vrijednost kompanije procjenjuje se na oko 1.500 milijardi dolara.
The value of the company is estimated at about 1,500 billion dollars.
Debi je bio dobar iako je cijelo tržište tog dana padalo.
The debut was good even though the whole market was falling that day.
Osnivači Dario i Daniela Amodei otvorili su trgovanje i govorili o koristima i rizicima umjetne inteligencije.
The founders Dario and Daniela Amodei opened trading and spoke about the benefits and risks of artificial intelligence.
Dario Amodei je rekao da bi i druge kompanije mogle slijediti njihov primjer ako pokažu da sigurnost i uspjeh idu zajedno.
Dario Amodei said that other companies could follow their example if they show that safety and success go together.
Kompaniju su 2021. godine osnovali bivši istraživači OpenAI-ja, a u septembru je imala 14.000 poslovnih klijenata.
The company was founded in 2021 by former OpenAI researchers, and in September it had 14,000 business clients.

title: Supruga ga ismijala, a Everton mu ispunio trenerski san
His wife mocked him, but Everton made his coaching dream come true
body: Navijač Evertona star 37 godina postao je poznat na društvenim mrežama zbog jednog kratkog videa.
A 37-year-old Everton fan became famous on social media because of one short video.
Igrao je igricu Football Manager i u svojoj spavaćoj sobi održao izmišljenu konferenciju za medije kao trener Evertona.
He was playing the game Football Manager and held a made-up press conference in his bedroom as Everton's coach.
Tada je u sobu ušla njegova supruga i sve snimila telefonom.
Then his wife came into the room and filmed everything with her phone.
Ona mu se smijala i rekla da ima 37 godina i dvoje djece, a pretvara se da vodi ekipu.
She laughed at him and said that he was 37 and had two children, yet was pretending to run a team.
Snimak se brzo proširio internetom i došao je do samog kluba.
The clip quickly spread across the internet and reached the club itself.
Everton je zato odlučio da mu ispuni san i pozvao ga je u svoje prostorije.
Everton therefore decided to make his dream come true and invited him to its premises.
Tamo je održao pravu konferenciju za medije.
There he held a real press conference.
Klub je video objavio u srijedu, a navijača je dočekao kapiten James Tarkowski.
The club published the video on Wednesday, and captain James Tarkowski welcomed the fan.
Tarkowski mu je rekao: Dobro jutro, treneru, a on je odgovorio: Dobro jutro, kapitenu.
Tarkowski said to him: Good morning, coach, and he replied: Good morning, captain.
Navijač je kasnije rekao da je svima pričao da je kapiten bio tamo.
The fan later said that he had told everyone that the captain was there.

title: Islamska zajednica pokazala izgled novog centra na Ilidži
Islamic Community shows the look of a new centre in Ilidža
body: Medžlis Islamske zajednice Sarajevo objavio je video s idejnim rješenjem novog centra na Ilidži.
The Medžlis of the Islamic Community Sarajevo published a video with the conceptual design of a new centre in Ilidža.
Kulturno-edukativni centar bit će izgrađen pored Centralne džamije u naselju Pejton.
The cultural and educational centre will be built next to the Central Mosque in the Pejton neighbourhood.
U njemu će se održavati vjerske, kulturne i obrazovne aktivnosti.
Religious, cultural and educational activities will be held in it.
Općinsko vijeće Ilidže usvojilo je izmjene plana 29. oktobra, a one su stupile na snagu u novembru.
The Ilidža Municipal Council adopted the changes to the plan on 29 October, and they came into force in November.
Lokacija u ulici 12. mart ima 1,11 hektara.
The site on 12. mart street covers 1.11 hectares.
Zgrada će imati podrum, prizemlje i jedan sprat, a ukupna površina može biti najviše 2.615 kvadratnih metara.
The building will have a basement, a ground floor and one storey, and the total area can be at most 2,615 square metres.
U podrumu će biti garaža s najmanje 65 parking mjesta.
In the basement there will be a garage with at least 65 parking spaces.
Garaža će služiti posjetiocima džamije i centra, ali i stanovnicima naselja.
The garage will serve visitors to the mosque and the centre, but also residents of the neighbourhood.
Novi centar bi trebao zamijeniti stare garaže koje se sada nalaze na tom mjestu.
The new centre should replace the old garages that are now on that site.
Plan predviđa i novu cestu dugu 200 metara uz rijeku Željeznicu, pa će Pejton dobiti drugi ulaz i izlaz.
The plan also includes a new 200-metre road along the Željeznica river, so Pejton will get a second entrance and exit.

title: Emina Jahović otkrila kako se hrani: dva obroka dnevno
Emina Jahović revealed how she eats: two meals a day
body: Pjevačica Emina Jahović za srbijanski portal Blic govorila je o tome kako se hrani.
Singer Emina Jahović spoke to the Serbian portal Blic about how she eats.
Ona kaže da nema tri obroka dnevno, nego samo jedan ili dva.
She says that she doesn't have three meals a day, but only one or two.
Često preskače doručak, a dan završava laganom večerom oko 18 ili 19 sati.
She often skips breakfast and ends the day with a light dinner around 6 or 7 pm.
Između obroka ne jede ništa, a ranije je rekla da ponekad posti i do 48 sati.
She eats nothing between meals, and she said earlier that she sometimes fasts for up to 48 hours.
Izbacila je mliječne proizvode i izbjegava gluten, protein u kojem ima brašna od pšenice.
She has cut out dairy products and avoids gluten, a protein found in wheat flour.
Većinu proteina dobija iz mesa i mnogo trenira.
She gets most of her protein from meat and trains a lot.
Ajvar ne kupuje u prodavnici, nego ga pravi njena majka u Novom Pazaru s maslinovim uljem.
She doesn't buy ajvar in a shop; her mother makes it in Novi Pazar with olive oil.
Rekla je da ne pojede cijelu teglu ajvara, nego dvije kašike.
She said that she doesn't eat a whole jar of ajvar, but two spoonfuls.
Jedini porok koji priznaje je kafa, jer joj smanjuje glad.
The only vice she admits to is coffee, because it reduces her hunger.
Kada prekrši pravila, počasti se picom s Nutellom, vaflima i čokoladom.
When she breaks the rules, she treats herself to pizza with Nutella, waffles and chocolate.

title: Zašto se današnja djeca kreću manje nego ranije
Why today's children move less than before
body: Današnja djeca često imaju organizirane treninge, ali tokom dana mnogo više sjede nego ranije generacije.
Today's children often have organised training sessions, but during the day they sit much more than earlier generations.
O tome piše kineziolog i atletski trener Elmir Ćerimagić, koji je i otac četvero djece.
Kinesiologist and athletics coach Elmir Ćerimagić, who is also a father of four, writes about this.
On smatra da trening ne može zamijeniti slobodnu igru.
He believes that training cannot replace free play.
Ranije su se djeca penjala na drveće, skakala preko potoka i igrala žmire i lastiš.
Earlier, children climbed trees, jumped over streams and played hide-and-seek and elastics.
Tako su razvijala ravnotežu, snagu i koordinaciju, a da to nisu ni znala.
That way they developed balance, strength and coordination without even knowing it.
Danas dijete može imati 3 treninga nogometa sedmično, a ostatak dana provodi u školi, uz telefon ili televizor.
Today a child can have 3 football sessions a week, and spends the rest of the day at school, with a phone or the TV.
Svjetska zdravstvena organizacija preporučuje djeci od 5 do 17 godina najmanje 60 minuta kretanja dnevno.
The World Health Organization recommends at least 60 minutes of movement a day for children aged 5 to 17.
Autor kaže da roditelji često zabranjuju djeci da se penju i skaču, ili sve urade umjesto njih.
The author says that parents often forbid children to climb and jump, or do everything for them.
On savjetuje svakodnevnu igru napolju i različite pokrete, kao što su skakanje, puzanje i balansiranje.
He advises daily outdoor play and different movements, such as jumping, crawling and balancing.
Organizirani sport treba biti dodatak, a ne zamjena za kretanje.
Organised sport should be an addition, not a replacement for movement.

title: Tužilaštvo traži pritvor za uhapšenu inspektoricu SIPA-e
Prosecutors seek detention for arrested SIPA inspector
body: Pred Sudom BiH danas je održano ročište o pritvoru za inspektoricu SIPA-e Jelenu Mičić.
A hearing on detention for SIPA inspector Jelena Mičić was held today before the Court of BiH.
Sumnja se da je zloupotrijebila položaj i da je preko brata upozorila kriminalca Miljana Radonju na istragu.
She is suspected of abusing her position and of warning the criminal Miljan Radonja about an investigation through her brother.
Za to krivično djelo prijeti kazna od 6 mjeseci do 5 godina zatvora.
That criminal offence carries a sentence of 6 months to 5 years in prison.
Tužilac je tražio jedan mjesec pritvora, jer bi ona mogla uništiti dokaze ili uticati na svjedoke.
The prosecutor asked for one month of detention, because she could destroy evidence or influence witnesses.
Prema tužilaštvu, njen brat je informaciju poslao Radonji preko aplikacije Sky 2021. godine.
According to the prosecution, her brother sent the information to Radonja via the Sky app in 2021.
Policija joj je oduzela telefon, ali ona nije htjela dati šifru.
The police seized her phone, but she would not give the password.
Kod nje je pronađen i USB s obavještajnim podacima iz 2021. godine.
A USB stick with intelligence data from 2021 was also found with her.
Odbrana je rekla da poruke nisu dokazane i da je šutnja njeno pravo.
The defence said the messages had not been proven and that silence is her right.
Advokati su predložili blaže mjere, na primjer zabranu razgovora o predmetu.
The lawyers proposed milder measures, for example a ban on talking about the case.
Naveli su i da je ona majka dvoje djece i da brine o baki.
They also stated that she is a mother of two children and looks after her grandmother.
Sud će odluku o pritvoru donijeti naknadno.
The court will make its decision on detention later.

title: Zagreb proglašen najboljom božićnom destinacijom u Evropi
Zagreb named the best Christmas destination in Europe
body: Platforma European Best Destinations proglasila je Zagreb najboljom božićnom destinacijom u Evropi za 2026. godinu.
The platform European Best Destinations named Zagreb the best Christmas destination in Europe for 2026.
Na drugom mjestu je Sofija, a na četvrtom Budimpešta.
Sofia is in second place, and Budapest is fourth.
Platforma nije objasnila kako je birala gradove, ali kaže da Zagreb nudi posebnu atmosferu.
The platform did not explain how it chose the cities, but it says that Zagreb offers a special atmosphere.
Advent u Zagrebu je već tri godine zaredom bio najbolji božićni sajam u Evropi.
Advent in Zagreb was already the best Christmas market in Europe three years in a row.
Ove godine službeno počinje u subotu, 28. novembra, i traje do 7. januara 2027. godine.
This year it officially starts on Saturday, 28 November, and lasts until 7 January 2027.
Neke lokacije bi mogle biti otvorene već od 25. novembra.
Some locations could be open as early as 25 November.
Program će biti na više mjesta u centru, a na Trgu kralja Tomislava bit će i ledeni park.
The programme will be in several places in the centre, and there will also be an ice park on King Tomislav Square.
Na listi od 10 destinacija su i Beč, Lisabon, Riga i Salamanca.
Vienna, Lisbon, Riga and Salamanca are also on the list of 10 destinations.
Deseto mjesto pripalo je Mariboru u Sloveniji.
Tenth place went to Maribor in Slovenia.
Advent će početi paljenjem prve svijeće na Trgu bana Jelačića.
Advent will begin with the lighting of the first candle on Ban Jelačić Square.

title: Novak Đoković glumi u novoj komediji s Robertom De Nirom
Novak Đoković acts in a new comedy with Robert De Niro
body: Teniser Novak Đoković ima malu ulogu u filmu Focker-In-Law, četvrtom dijelu poznate komedije.
Tennis player Novak Đoković has a small role in the film Focker-In-Law, the fourth part of a well-known comedy.
Scena s njim može se vidjeti u najavi filma, koju je objavio regionalni distributer.
The scene with him can be seen in the film's trailer, which was published by the regional distributor.
Film u američka kina stiže 25. novembra.
The film arrives in American cinemas on 25 November.
U sceni Đoković nosi bijelu majicu i torbu s reketima, a razgovara s Owenom Wilsonom.
In the scene Đoković wears a white T-shirt and a racket bag, and talks with Owen Wilson.
Kaže mu da je trening bio odličan i da treba nastaviti raditi na forhendu.
He tells him the training was excellent and that he should keep working on his forehand.
Kada ga Wilson pita za bekhend, Đoković odgovara da može i bolje.
When Wilson asks him about the backhand, Đoković replies that he can do better.
U istom kadru su i Robert De Niro i Teri Polo.
Robert De Niro and Teri Polo are also in the same shot.
U filmu se vraćaju Ben Stiller, Robert De Niro i Owen Wilson, a nova je i Ariana Grande.
Ben Stiller, Robert De Niro and Owen Wilson return in the film, and Ariana Grande is new.
Film je napisao i režirao John Hamburg, koji je radio i na prethodna tri dijela.
The film was written and directed by John Hamburg, who also worked on the previous three parts.
Ovo nije prvi Đokovićev film, jer se 2011. godine kratko pojavio i u filmu The Expendables 2.
This is not Đoković's first film, because in 2011 he also briefly appeared in the film The Expendables 2.

title: Fizioterapeut upozorava igrače GTA 6 na duge sate sjedenja
Physiotherapist warns GTA 6 players about long hours of sitting
body: Mnogi ljudi ovih dana satima igraju novu video igru GTA 6.
Many people are playing the new video game GTA 6 for hours these days.
Fizioterapeut Anthony Pavlich za New York Post upozorava da dugo igranje bez pauze može štetiti zdravlju.
Physiotherapist Anthony Pavlich warns in the New York Post that long gaming without a break can harm health.
Najčešći problemi su bol u vratu i leđima, problemi sa zglobom šake i slabiji protok krvi u nogama.
The most common problems are neck and back pain, wrist problems and weaker blood flow in the legs.
Većina igrača sjedi pogrbljeno na kauču, a glava teška oko 5 kilograma opterećuje vrat.
Most players sit hunched on the couch, and the head, which weighs about 5 kilograms, strains the neck.
Prema jednom istraživanju iz 2015. godine, 6 sati sjedenja smanjuje protok krvi u nogama.
According to one study from 2015, 6 hours of sitting reduces blood flow in the legs.
Šetnja od 10 minuta nakon toga vratila je vrijednosti u normalu.
A 10-minute walk afterwards brought the values back to normal.
Ako se tako sjedi mjesecima, mišići mogu postati kraći i slabiji.
If people sit like that for months, the muscles can become shorter and weaker.
Pavlich kaže da ne postoji tačan broj sati koji je siguran za odrasle.
Pavlich says that there is no exact number of hours that is safe for adults.
Savjetuje da svakih 30 do 60 minuta ustanete i krećete se 2 do 5 minuta.
He advises getting up every 30 to 60 minutes and moving for 2 to 5 minutes.
On preporučuje i nekoliko jednostavnih vježbi istezanja za vrat, prsa, kukove i ruke.
He also recommends several simple stretching exercises for the neck, chest, hips and arms.

title: Voyager 1 se javio s udaljenosti od jednog svjetlosnog dana
Voyager 1 called in from a distance of one light-day
body: NASA-ina letjelica Voyager 1 poslala je signal kontrolorima na Zemlji s rekordne udaljenosti.
NASA's spacecraft Voyager 1 sent a signal to controllers on Earth from a record distance.
Signal je putovao tačno 24 sata, pa je letjelica udaljena jedan svjetlosni dan.
The signal travelled for exactly 24 hours, so the spacecraft is one light-day away.
To je udaljenost koju svjetlost pređe za jedan dan, više od 26 milijardi kilometara.
That is the distance light travels in one day, more than 26 billion kilometres.
Nijedna letjelica koju su napravili ljudi nije bila tako daleko.
No spacecraft made by humans has ever been so far away.
Voyager 1 lansiran je 1977. godine, a 1990. snimio je poznatu fotografiju Zemlje „Pale Blue Dot“.
Voyager 1 was launched in 1977, and in 1990 it took the famous photograph of Earth "Pale Blue Dot".
U međuzvjezdani prostor, daleko izvan utjecaja Sunca, ušao je 2012. godine.
It entered interstellar space, far beyond the influence of the Sun, in 2012.
Letjelica ima 49 godina i kreće se brzinom od oko 61.000 kilometara na sat.
The spacecraft is 49 years old and moves at a speed of about 61,000 kilometres per hour.
Dave Gallagher, direktor NASA-ine laboratorije JPL, rekao je da je to novi važan trenutak misije.
Dave Gallagher, director of NASA's JPL laboratory, said that it was a new important moment for the mission.
Kamere su odavno ugašene, a većina instrumenata isključena je da bi se štedjela energija.
The cameras were switched off long ago, and most instruments have been turned off to save energy.
Ipak, letjelica i dalje skoro svaki dan šalje podatke.
Still, the spacecraft keeps sending data almost every day.
Na njoj je i Zlatna ploča sa zvukovima Zemlje, koja bi mogla trajati više od milijardu godina.
It also carries the Golden Record with sounds of Earth, which could last more than a billion years.

title: Aleksandar Čupić novi predsjednik Skupštine Srbije
Aleksandar Čupić is the new speaker of Serbia's parliament
body: Poslanici Skupštine Srbije u četvrtak su izabrali Aleksandra Čupića za predsjednika Skupštine.
On Thursday MPs in Serbia's parliament elected Aleksandar Čupić as speaker of parliament.
Čupić je poslanik Studentske liste i docent na Saobraćajnom fakultetu u Beogradu.
Čupić is an MP of the Student List and an assistant professor at the Faculty of Transport in Belgrade.
Izbor je došao nakon sjednice koja je trebala trajati 5 sati, a trajala je 3 dana.
The election came after a session that was supposed to last 5 hours, but lasted 3 days.
Čupić je dobio 140 glasova, a trebalo mu je najmanje 126.
Čupić received 140 votes, and he needed at least 126.
Kandidat SNS-a Stojan Radenović dobio je 97 glasova.
The SNS candidate Stojan Radenović received 97 votes.
Aleksandar Vučić je prvog dana govorio 1 sat i 40 minuta, a drugog dana se javio za riječ oko 30 puta.
Aleksandar Vučić spoke for 1 hour and 40 minutes on the first day, and on the second day took the floor about 30 times.
Zato je Studentska lista posljednjeg dana povukla sve svoje govornike kako bi se brže glasalo.
That is why on the last day the Student List withdrew all its speakers so the vote could happen sooner.
Poslanici SNS-a tražili su da Čupić objasni porijeklo svoje imovine.
SNS MPs asked Čupić to explain the origin of his assets.
On je rekao da će izvještaj o imovini predati Agenciji za borbu protiv korupcije.
He said he would submit a report on his assets to the Anti-Corruption Agency.
Kao predsjednik Skupštine, Čupić će biti i vršilac dužnosti predsjednika Srbije.
As speaker of parliament, Čupić will also be acting president of Serbia.
Do 27. novembra mora raspisati predsjedničke izbore.
By 27 November he must call presidential elections.

title: Putin zadovoljan sastankom s Trumpom i Xijem
Putin pleased with the meeting with Trump and Xi
body: Ruski predsjednik Vladimir Putin u četvrtak je u Shenzhenu govorio novinarima o sastanku s Donaldom Trumpom i Xi Jinpingom.
On Thursday in Shenzhen, Russian President Vladimir Putin spoke to journalists about the meeting with Donald Trump and Xi Jinping.
Rekao je da ovakav sastanak tri lidera nikada prije nije održan.
He said that such a meeting of three leaders had never been held before.
Prema njegovim riječima, to je novo poglavlje u historiji diplomatije.
In his words, it is a new chapter in the history of diplomacy.
Lideri su razgovarali o ratu u Ukrajini, Bliskom istoku i Korejskom poluotoku.
The leaders talked about the war in Ukraine, the Middle East and the Korean Peninsula.
Razgovarali su i o reformi Ujedinjenih nacija, koje bi, kako kaže Putin, trebalo prilagoditi današnjem svijetu.
They also talked about reforming the United Nations, which, as Putin says, should be adapted to today's world.
Putinu se posebno svidio dio sastanka nakon zvaničnih govora, kada su lideri otvoreno razgovarali pred novinarima.
Putin especially liked the part of the meeting after the official speeches, when the leaders talked openly in front of journalists.
Putin je rekao da bi volio da se ovakvi sastanci nastave.
Putin said he would like such meetings to continue.
Dodao je da su i teški dogovori bolji nego nikakvi.
He added that even difficult agreements are better than none.
Rekao je i da je politički sistem SAD-a komplikovan.
He also said that the US political system is complicated.
Ipak, ne sumnja da Trump iskreno želi završiti sukobe, uključujući rat u Ukrajini.
Still, he has no doubt that Trump sincerely wants to end conflicts, including the war in Ukraine.

title: Opera Narodnog pozorišta Sarajevo slavi 80 godina
The Opera of the National Theatre Sarajevo celebrates 80 years
body: Narodno pozorište Sarajevo večeras u 19:30 počinje proslavu 80 godina svoje Opere.
This evening at 19:30 the National Theatre Sarajevo begins the celebration of 80 years of its Opera.
Proslava počinje gala koncertom na kojem nastupaju solisti i hor Opere.
The celebration starts with a gala concert at which soloists and the Opera choir perform.
Prati ih Sarajevska filharmonija, a dirigent je Dario Vučić.
They are accompanied by the Sarajevo Philharmonic, and the conductor is Dario Vučić.
Publika će čuti arije, duete i horske kompozicije Verdija, Puccinija, Rossinija, Bizeta i drugih kompozitora.
The audience will hear arias, duets and choral pieces by Verdi, Puccini, Rossini, Bizet and other composers.
Na programu su i djela bh. kompozitora Asima Horozića i Ammara Jažića.
The programme also includes works by BiH composers Asim Horozić and Ammar Jažić.
Arija kralja Renéa iz Čajkovskijeve opere Iolanta prvi put će se izvesti na sceni NPS-a.
The aria of King René from Tchaikovsky's opera Iolanta will be performed for the first time on the NPS stage.
Mecosopranistica Hanadi Karić prvi put nastupa na gala koncertu.
Mezzo-soprano Hanadi Karić is performing at a gala concert for the first time.
Vučić je rekao da je program muzički pregled osam decenija Opere.
Vučić said that the programme is a musical overview of eight decades of the Opera.
Publika će čuti djela koja su izvedena u Sarajevu, ali i ona koja grad još nije čuo.
The audience will hear works that have been performed in Sarajevo, but also ones the city has not heard yet.
Historija Opere počela je 9. novembra 1946. godine, kada je izvedena Smetanina Prodana nevjesta.
The Opera's history began on 9 November 1946, when Smetana's The Bartered Bride was performed.

title: Sud u Hagu: Mijanmar je kriv za genocid nad Rohingyama
Court in The Hague: Myanmar is guilty of genocide against the Rohingya
body: Međunarodni sud pravde u Hagu u četvrtak je presudio da je Mijanmar počinio genocid nad Rohingya muslimanima.
On Thursday the International Court of Justice in The Hague ruled that Myanmar committed genocide against Rohingya Muslims.
To je prvi put u historiji da je ovaj sud neku državu proglasio odgovornom za genocid.
It is the first time in history that this court has declared a state responsible for genocide.
Presudu je pročitao predsjednik suda Yuji Iwasawa.
The verdict was read by the president of the court, Yuji Iwasawa.
Sudije su odlučile sa 9 glasova za i 6 protiv.
The judges decided with 9 votes for and 6 against.
Slučaj je 2019. godine pokrenula Gambija.
The case was started in 2019 by The Gambia.
Prema sudu, snage sigurnosti Mijanmara su 2017. godine u državi Rakhine ubile oko 10.000 Rohingya.
According to the court, Myanmar's security forces killed about 10,000 Rohingya in Rakhine State in 2017.
Oko 740.000 ljudi tada je pobjeglo u susjedni Bangladeš.
About 740,000 people then fled to neighbouring Bangladesh.
Mijanmar negira genocid i kaže da je akcija bila usmjerena protiv pobunjenika.
Myanmar denies genocide and says the operation was aimed at insurgents.
Isti sud je 2007. godine, u slučaju koji je pokrenula BiH, presudio da je u Srebrenici počinjen genocid.
In 2007, in a case brought by BiH, the same court ruled that genocide was committed in Srebrenica.
Tada je zaključio da Srbija nije direktno odgovorna, ali da genocid nije spriječila.
It then concluded that Serbia was not directly responsible, but that it had not prevented the genocide.
Nova presuda bi mogla biti važna i za slučaj Južne Afrike protiv Izraela zbog rata u Gazi.
The new ruling could also be important for South Africa's case against Israel over the war in Gaza.

title: Šta dalje čeka letjelicu Voyager 1
What lies ahead for the Voyager 1 spacecraft
body: Voyager 1 postao je prva letjelica koja je od Zemlje udaljena jedan svjetlosni dan.
Voyager 1 has become the first spacecraft to be one light-day away from Earth.
To znači da njegovom signalu treba cijeli dan da stigne do nas.
This means its signal needs a whole day to reach us.
NASA sada planira da do 50. rođendana misije, u septembru 2027. godine, ne mijenja mnogo u radu letjelice.
NASA now plans not to change much in how the spacecraft works until the mission's 50th birthday in September 2027.
Voyager 1 i dalje mjeri magnetno polje, plazmu i čestice dok se udaljava od Sunca.
Voyager 1 still measures the magnetic field, plasma and particles as it moves away from the Sun.
Naučnici žele saznati gdje prestaje uticaj Sunca i počinje međuzvjezdani prostor.
Scientists want to find out where the Sun's influence ends and interstellar space begins.
Problem je energija, jer obje letjelice Voyager svake godine gube oko 4 vata.
The problem is energy, because both Voyager spacecraft lose about 4 watts every year.
Na početku su imale 470 vati, a neki instrumenti su već isključeni.
At the start they had 470 watts, and some instruments have already been switched off.
Prošlog mjeseca Voyager 1 oko 48 sati nije odgovarao na komande, ali se brzo oporavio.
Last month Voyager 1 did not respond to commands for about 48 hours, but it recovered quickly.
Menadžerica projekta Suzanne Dodd rekla je da je cilj da letjelica radi što duže.
Project manager Suzanne Dodd said the goal is for the spacecraft to keep working as long as possible.
Voyager 2 je u međuzvjezdani prostor ušao 2018. godine.
Voyager 2 entered interstellar space in 2018.
Do udaljenosti od jednog svjetlosnog dana trebao bi stići oko 2035. godine.
It should reach a distance of one light-day around 2035.

title: Upozorenje: Večeras jak vjetar do 90 km/h u BiH
Warning: strong wind up to 90 km/h in BiH this evening
body: Meteorolozi upozoravaju da se danas u BiH očekuju olujni udari vjetra.
Meteorologists warn that storm-force wind gusts are expected in BiH today.
Jak vjetar bi trebao puhati od 16:00 do 21:00 sat.
The strong wind should blow from 16:00 to 21:00.
Prema BH Meteu, vjetar donosi duboki ciklon koji prolazi sjeverno od regije.
According to BH Meteo, the wind is brought by a deep cyclone passing north of the region.
Najjači udari, od 60 do 90 km/h, očekuju se navečer na sjeveru i sjeveroistoku Bosne.
The strongest gusts, from 60 to 90 km/h, are expected in the evening in the north and northeast of Bosnia.
Sličan vjetar bit će i u planinskim i brdskim krajevima.
There will be similar wind in mountain and hill areas.
U kotlinama centralne i istočne Bosne, kao i u nizinama Hercegovine, vjetar će biti nešto slabiji, ali i dalje jak.
In the basins of central and eastern Bosnia, as well as in the lowlands of Herzegovina, the wind will be somewhat weaker, but still strong.
U Hercegovini i jugozapadnoj Bosni očekuje se obilna kiša, od 15 do 40 litara po metru kvadratnom.
Heavy rain is expected in Herzegovina and southwestern Bosnia, from 15 to 40 litres per square metre.
U planinama sjeverno od Mostara moglo bi pasti i do 90 litara.
In the mountains north of Mostar up to 90 litres could fall.
Federalni hidrometeorološki zavod također je izdao upozorenje zbog vjetra i obilnih padavina.
The Federal Hydrometeorological Institute has also issued a warning because of wind and heavy precipitation.
Prema zavodu, u regijama Banje Luke, Prijedora i Trebinja vjetar bi mogao čupati drveće.
According to the institute, in the Banja Luka, Prijedor and Trebinje regions the wind could uproot trees.
Mogući su i nestanci struje, zato građani trebaju biti posebno oprezni.
Power cuts are also possible, so citizens should be especially careful.

title: Xi, Putin i Trump objavili zajedničku deklaraciju o miru
Xi, Putin and Trump publish a joint peace declaration
body: Lideri Kine, Rusije i SAD-a sastali su se u četvrtak u kineskom gradu Shenzhenu.
The leaders of China, Russia and the US met on Thursday in the Chinese city of Shenzhen.
Sastanak je održan na marginama samita APEC-a, a domaćin je bio kineski predsjednik Xi Jinping.
The meeting was held on the sidelines of the APEC summit, and the host was Chinese President Xi Jinping.
Nakon razgovora su kineski državni mediji objavili deklaraciju o miru koja ima četiri tačke.
After the talks, Chinese state media published a peace declaration with four points.
U prvoj tački tri zemlje kažu da žele reformu Ujedinjenih nacija.
In the first point the three countries say they want reform of the United Nations.
Sve tri su stalne članice Vijeća sigurnosti UN-a.
All three are permanent members of the UN Security Council.
Druga tačka govori o nafti, jer žele proizvoditi i isporučivati više naftnih derivata.
The second point is about oil, because they want to produce and supply more refined oil products.
U trećoj tački piše da Međunarodni krivični sud ne smije zloupotrebljavati svoju nadležnost.
The third point says that the International Criminal Court must not abuse its jurisdiction.
Četvrta tačka kaže da se nuklearni rat ne može dobiti i da se nikada ne smije voditi.
The fourth point says that a nuclear war cannot be won and must never be fought.
Lideri su rekli da će razgovarati o tome kako smanjiti nuklearne rizike.
The leaders said they would talk about how to reduce nuclear risks.
Ruski mediji su ubrzo objavili isti tekst deklaracije.
Russian media soon published the same text of the declaration.
Iz SAD-a još nije stigla zvanična izjava o dokumentu.
No official statement about the document has come from the US yet.

title: Burna rasprava u Skupštini Srbije o vezama s kriminalcima
Heated debate in Serbia's parliament about ties to criminals
body: Na sjednici Skupštine Srbije u Beogradu ponovo je bilo burno.
It was stormy again at the session of Serbia's parliament in Belgrade.
Poslanik Studentske liste Jovo Bakić vikao je dok je optuživao Aleksandra Vučića i SNS za veze s kriminalcima.
Student List MP Jovo Bakić shouted while accusing Aleksandar Vučić and the SNS of ties to criminals.
Poslanici vladajuće koalicije dobacivali su mu, pa je on podigao glas.
MPs of the ruling coalition heckled him, so he raised his voice.
Bakić je rekao da SNS i Vučić imaju veze s navijačkim grupama, koje je nazvao dilerima droge.
Bakić said that SNS and Vučić have ties to football fan groups, which he called drug dealers.
Prema njegovim riječima, te grupe su čuvale Vučića na inauguraciji 2017. godine.
In his words, these groups guarded Vučić at his inauguration in 2017.
Spomenuo je i škaljarski i kavački klan, kao i Veljka Belivuka i Luku Bojovića.
He also mentioned the Škaljari and Kavač clans, as well as Veljko Belivuk and Luka Bojović.
Bakić je govorio i o Milanu Radoičiću.
Bakić also spoke about Milan Radoičić.
Rekao je da je Radoičić smio sjediti na galeriji Skupštine, a studenti nisu.
He said that Radoičić was allowed to sit in the parliament gallery, but the students were not.
Dodao je da je Vučić prvo tvrdio da ga ne poznaje, a kasnije ga je nazvao zaštitnikom Srba na Kosovu.
He added that Vučić first claimed not to know him, and later called him a protector of Serbs in Kosovo.
Na kraju je pitao ima li veće sramote za srpski narod.
In the end he asked whether there was a greater shame for the Serbian people.

title: Kome dodaci vitamina D zaista pomažu
Who vitamin D supplements really help
body: Velika istraživanja pokazuju da dodaci vitamina D ne produžavaju život ljudima koji već imaju dovoljno ovog vitamina.
Large studies show that vitamin D supplements do not extend the lives of people who already have enough of this vitamin.
Oni im ne smanjuju ni rizik od raka ili bolesti srca.
Nor do they reduce their risk of cancer or heart disease.
Ipak, ljudima koji imaju manjak vitamina D on je potreban za kosti i mišiće.
Still, people who lack vitamin D need it for their bones and muscles.
U najnovijoj britanskoj studiji učestvovalo je 3.886 pacijenata na dijalizi.
3,886 dialysis patients took part in the newest British study.
Dijaliza je postupak koji čisti krv kada bubrezi ne rade dobro.
Dialysis is a procedure that cleans the blood when the kidneys do not work well.
Visoka doza vitamina D nije im produžila život niti smanjila probleme sa srcem.
A high dose of vitamin D did not extend their lives or reduce heart problems.
U američkoj studiji VITAL skoro 26.000 odraslih je u prosjeku 5,3 godine uzimalo vitamin D ili placebo.
In the American VITAL study, almost 26,000 adults took vitamin D or a placebo for 5.3 years on average.
Ni tu nije bilo velike razlike kod raka i bolesti srca.
There was no big difference in cancer and heart disease there either.
Manjak vitamina D češće imaju starije osobe, dojenčad, osobe s tamnijom kožom i ljudi koji su malo na suncu.
Older people, breastfed babies, people with darker skin and people who spend little time in the sun lack vitamin D more often.
Britanski NHS savjetuje da odrasli ne uzimaju više od 4.000 IU dnevno.
The British NHS advises adults not to take more than 4,000 IU a day.
Previše vitamina D može oštetiti kosti, bubrege i srce.
Too much vitamin D can damage the bones, kidneys and heart.
Zato je najbolje razgovarati s doktorom, koji može uraditi jednostavnu analizu krvi.
That is why it is best to talk to a doctor, who can do a simple blood test.

title: Banke u FBiH moraju nuditi jeftin paket usluga
Banks in FBiH must offer a cheap service package
body: Agencija za bankarstvo FBiH donijela je odluku koja ograničava cijenu osnovnih bankarskih usluga.
The FBiH Banking Agency has adopted a decision that limits the price of basic banking services.
Od 28. februara 2027. godine banke moraju nuditi paket usluga uz platni račun.
From 28 February 2027 banks must offer a service package with a payment account.
Mjesečna naknada za taj paket ne smije biti veća od 0,2% prosječne neto plate u Federaciji.
The monthly fee for this package must not be higher than 0.2% of the average net salary in the Federation.
Paket uključuje otvaranje i vođenje računa, kao i internet i mobilno bankarstvo.
The package includes opening and keeping an account, as well as internet and mobile banking.
Korisnici mogu svaki mjesec poslati 10 uplata u druge banke i 10 uplata unutar iste banke.
Users can send 10 payments to other banks and 10 payments within the same bank every month.
Plaćanje karticom u trgovinama u BiH nije ograničeno, a debitna kartica je dio paketa.
Card payments in shops in BiH are unlimited, and a debit card is part of the package.
Za svaku dodatnu uplatu banka će naplatiti redovnu cijenu.
For each extra payment the bank will charge the regular price.
Banke ne smiju uvoditi skrivene naknade da bi zaobišle odluku.
Banks must not introduce hidden fees in order to get around the decision.
Uslove i cijene moraju jasno objaviti na internet stranicama i u poslovnicama.
They must clearly publish the conditions and prices on their websites and in their branches.
Odluka traži i da banke misle na starije osobe, osobe s invaliditetom i ljude sa slabijim digitalnim znanjem.
The decision also requires banks to keep in mind older people, people with disabilities and people with weaker digital skills.

title: Zašto antibiotik ne pomaže kod gripe i prehlade
Why an antibiotic does not help with flu and a cold
body: Svjetska zdravstvena organizacija upozorava da antibiotici ne djeluju protiv virusa.
The World Health Organization warns that antibiotics do not work against viruses.
Gripu, prehladu, većinu upala grla i bronhitis izazivaju virusi, pa tu antibiotik ne pomaže.
Flu, colds, most sore throats and bronchitis are caused by viruses, so an antibiotic does not help there.
Antibiotici liječe bakterijske infekcije, na primjer upalu pluća i tuberkulozu.
Antibiotics treat bacterial infections, for example pneumonia and tuberculosis.
Kada ljudi uzimaju antibiotike bez potrebe, bakterije postaju otporne i infekcije se teže liječe.
When people take antibiotics without need, bacteria become resistant and infections are harder to treat.
U anketama je čak 64 posto ljudi pogrešno mislilo da se gripa i prehlada liječe antibioticima.
In surveys as many as 64 percent of people wrongly thought that flu and colds are treated with antibiotics.
U 2023. godini svaka šesta bakterijska infekcija u svijetu bila je otporna na antibiotike.
In 2023 every sixth bacterial infection in the world was resistant to antibiotics.
Prema UN-u, otpornost bakterija povezana je s više od 4,7 miliona smrti godišnje.
According to the UN, bacterial resistance is linked to more than 4.7 million deaths a year.
Ove sedmice, od 18. do 24. novembra, obilježava se svjetska sedmica svijesti o ovom problemu.
This week, from 18 to 24 November, a world awareness week about this problem is being marked.
Stručnjaci savjetuju da se antibiotik uzima samo kada ga prepiše ljekar.
Experts advise that an antibiotic be taken only when a doctor prescribes it.
Ako ga dobijete, terapiju treba završiti do kraja, a lijekove koji ostanu ne treba bacati u odvod.
If you get one, the therapy should be finished to the end, and medicines that are left over should not be thrown down the drain.

title: Conor McGregor dao radnicima slobodan dan zbog GTA 6
Conor McGregor gave workers a day off because of GTA 6
body: Bivši UFC prvak Conor McGregor dao je slobodan dan svim radnicima u svojim kompanijama.
Former UFC champion Conor McGregor gave a day off to all the workers in his companies.
Razlog je izlazak nove igre Grand Theft Auto VI.
The reason is the release of the new game Grand Theft Auto VI.
Odluku je objavio na mreži X u srijedu navečer, manje od 12 sati prije nego što je igra izašla.
He announced the decision on the network X on Wednesday evening, less than 12 hours before the game came out.
McGregor kaže da zapošljava 400 ljudi u nekoliko zemalja na više kontinenata.
McGregor says he employs 400 people in several countries on several continents.
U poruci je poželio timu da uživa u igri.
In the message he wished the team to enjoy the game.
Potpisao se kao njihov prijatelj i šef.
He signed as their friend and boss.
Kasnije je objavio i video svog kutka za igranje, u kojem se vidio sat koji odbrojava do izlaska igre.
Later he also posted a video of his gaming corner, in which a clock counting down to the game's release could be seen.
GTA VI izašao je danas za PlayStation 5 i Xbox Series X/S.
GTA VI came out today for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S.
To je prva nova igra u ovom serijalu nakon 13 godina.
It is the first new game in this series after 13 years.
Priča se vraća u Vice City, a glavni likovi su Jason i Lucia.
The story returns to Vice City, and the main characters are Jason and Lucia.

title: Neobični detalji iz prvih sati igre GTA 6
Unusual details from the first hours of the game GTA 6
body: Novinar Klixa je u prvim satima igre GTA 6 otkrio mnogo neobičnih detalja.
A Klix journalist discovered many unusual details in the first hours of the game GTA 6.
Kaže da je najzabavnije istraživati svijet izvan zadataka.
He says it is most fun to explore the world outside the missions.
Grad se otvara polako, kako priča napreduje.
The city opens slowly, as the story progresses.
Prvi put u novijim GTA igrama automobilima može nestati goriva.
For the first time in recent GTA games cars can run out of fuel.
Rezervoar je prazan nakon 18 do 29 minuta vožnje, a punjenje traje oko 10 sekundi.
The tank is empty after 18 to 29 minutes of driving, and filling up takes about 10 seconds.
Policija se više ne vidi na mapi, a igrač može biti uhapšen ako samo stoji i gleda policijsku akciju.
The police can no longer be seen on the map, and the player can be arrested if he just stands and watches a police operation.
Ako ukrade avion iz vojne baze, odmah dobija pet zvjezdica, a vojni avioni ga brzo obore.
If he steals a plane from a military base, he immediately gets five stars, and military planes quickly shoot him down.
Jason može obrijati prsa u svojoj kući, ali za novu frizuru mora ići kod brijača.
Jason can shave his chest in his house, but for a new haircut he has to go to a barber.
Autor je primijetio i nekoliko grešaka, na primjer kada je Lucia propala kroz zemlju.
The author also noticed a few bugs, for example when Lucia fell through the ground.
Ipak, on misli da je to samo nekoliko grešaka u igri koja je inače dobro urađena.
Still, he thinks these are only a few bugs in a game that is otherwise well made.

title: Ukrajina ponovo napala Krimski most, saobraćaj prekinut
Ukraine attacked the Crimean Bridge again, traffic stopped
body: Krimski most ponovo je napadnut u četvrtak u ranim jutarnjim satima.
The Crimean Bridge was attacked again on Thursday in the early morning hours.
To je na Telegramu objavio Sergej Aksjonov, guverner Krima kojeg je postavila Moskva.
This was announced on Telegram by Sergei Aksyonov, the governor of Crimea appointed by Moscow.
Saobraćaj preko mosta privremeno je zaustavljen, a hitne službe procjenjuju štetu.
Traffic over the bridge was temporarily stopped, and emergency services are assessing the damage.
Napad je došao samo nekoliko dana nakon što se dio mosta srušio u ranijem ukrajinskom udaru.
The attack came only a few days after part of the bridge collapsed in an earlier Ukrainian strike.
Most je dug oko 19 kilometara i najduži je u Evropi, a koštao je 3,7 milijardi dolara.
The bridge is about 19 kilometres long and is the longest in Europe, and it cost 3.7 billion dollars.
Prema ruskim državnim medijima, napravljen je za 40.000 automobila dnevno.
According to Russian state media, it was built for 40,000 cars a day.
Za ruske trupe to je važan put za snabdijevanje, a za Putina i važan simbol.
For Russian troops it is an important supply route, and for Putin also an important symbol.
Ukrajinski predsjednik Volodimir Zelenski rekao je da su napadi na most odgovor na ruske udare na ukrajinsku infrastrukturu.
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said that the attacks on the bridge are a response to Russian strikes on Ukrainian infrastructure.
Napad se desio dok se Putin sprema za sastanak s Trumpom i Xi Jinpingom u Kini.
The attack happened while Putin is preparing for a meeting with Trump and Xi Jinping in China.
Portparol Kremlja Dmitrij Peskov ranije je rekao da će most biti obnovljen i da će biti bolji nego prije.
Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov said earlier that the bridge will be rebuilt and will be better than before.

title: Trump i Putin razgovarali 40 minuta na samitu u Kini
Trump and Putin talked for 40 minutes at the summit in China
body: Američki predsjednik Donald Trump i ruski predsjednik Vladimir Putin sastali su se jutros u kineskom gradu Shenzhenu.
US President Donald Trump and Russian President Vladimir Putin met this morning in the Chinese city of Shenzhen.
Oba lidera su tamo na samitu APEC-a, a prema CNN-u razgovor je trajao oko 40 minuta.
Both leaders are there for the APEC summit, and according to CNN the talk lasted about 40 minutes.
Pred kamerama je Trump rekao da on i Putin već mnogo godina imaju dobar odnos.
In front of the cameras Trump said that he and Putin have had a good relationship for many years.
Trump je dodao da iz ovog sastanka mogu proizaći divne stvari.
Trump added that wonderful things could come out of this meeting.
Putin se zatim rukovao s američkim državnim sekretarom Marcom Rubijem i ministrom finansija Scottom Bessentom.
Putin then shook hands with US Secretary of State Marco Rubio and Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent.
Bijela kuća kaže da to nije bio službeni bilateralni sastanak, nego kraći i manje formalan razgovor.
The White House says it was not an official bilateral meeting, but a shorter and less formal talk.
Trump i Putin su se kratko vidjeli i rukovali već u srijedu.
Trump and Putin had already briefly seen each other and shaken hands on Wednesday.
Ni Kremlj ni Bijela kuća još nisu rekli o čemu su lideri razgovarali.
Neither the Kremlin nor the White House has yet said what the leaders talked about.
Kasnije danas očekuje se i prvi zajednički sastanak Trumpa, Putina i kineskog predsjednika Xi Jinpinga.
Later today the first joint meeting of Trump, Putin and Chinese President Xi Jinping is also expected.
Glavne teme bi trebale biti sporazum o nuklearnom oružju i rat SAD-a s Iranom, a o Ukrajini vjerovatno neće biti riječi.
The main topics should be an agreement on nuclear weapons and the US war with Iran, and Ukraine will probably not be discussed.
Mediji ovaj susret porede s Jaltskom konferencijom iz februara 1945. godine.
The media compare this meeting with the Yalta Conference of February 1945.

title: Trump kaže da bi ponovo ušao u rat s Iranom
Trump says he would enter the war with Iran again
body: Američki predsjednik Donald Trump rekao je za Fox News da bi ponovo ratovao s Iranom.
US President Donald Trump told Fox News that he would go to war with Iran again.
Na pitanje da li bi opet donio istu odluku, odgovorio je da je odgovor apsolutno da.
Asked whether he would make the same decision again, he answered that the answer is absolutely yes.
Priznao je da je rat imao utjecaj na izbore, ali kaže da politika neće odlučivati o njegovim potezima.
He admitted that the war had an effect on the elections, but says politics will not decide his moves.
Trump tvrdi da Iran sada istražuje hemijsko i biološko oružje jer su mu američki napadi otežali put do nuklearne bombe.
Trump claims that Iran is now researching chemical and biological weapons because US attacks made its path to a nuclear bomb harder.
On kaže da su američke snage uništile iransku mornaricu, avijaciju i protivzračnu odbranu.
He says US forces destroyed the Iranian navy, air force and air defence.
Prema njegovim riječima, Iranu je ostalo samo 12 do 13 posto raketnih kapaciteta.
According to his words, Iran has only 12 to 13 percent of its missile capacity left.
Ipak, Wall Street Journal je 15. novembra pisao da Iran još ima između 1.500 i 2.500 raketa.
However, the Wall Street Journal wrote on 15 November that Iran still has between 1,500 and 2,500 missiles.
Trump je rekao da su raniji pregovori s Teheranom bili gubljenje vremena.
Trump said that the earlier negotiations with Tehran were a waste of time.
Dodao je da SAD ne treba pomoć Kine ili Rusije da završi rat.
He added that the US does not need help from China or Russia to end the war.
Ne vjeruje da će Iran napasti Washington, ali je zaprijetio jakim odgovorom ako se to desi.
He does not believe Iran will attack Washington, but he threatened a strong response if that happens.

title: Igra GTA 6 stigla je u Evropu, ovako izgleda početak
The game GTA 6 has arrived in Europe, this is what the beginning looks like
body: Igra GTA 6 stigla je u većinu evropskih zemalja tačno u ponoć.
The game GTA 6 arrived in most European countries exactly at midnight.
Novinar Klixa igrao je prve sate i opisao kako počinje priča.
A Klix journalist played the first hours and described how the story begins.
Igra ne počinje velikim ulaskom u Vice City, nego polako predstavlja svijet Leonide.
The game does not start with a big entry into Vice City, but slowly introduces the world of Leonida.
Na početku je Lucia Caminos u zatvoru, a kratki flashback pokazuje kako je tamo završila nakon pljačke prodavnice.
At the start Lucia Caminos is in prison, and a short flashback shows how she ended up there after a shop robbery.
Zatim se priča vraća na Jasona Duvala, čiji su prvi zadaci mirniji i svakodnevni.
Then the story returns to Jason Duval, whose first tasks are calmer and everyday.
On vozi brod i avion, a ima i dijelova u kojima se mora kretati tiho.
He drives a boat and a plane, and there are also parts where he has to move quietly.
Prvi sati igre dešavaju se u Key Lentu, manjem području koje je veoma drugačije od Vice Cityja.
The first hours of the game take place in Key Lento, a smaller area that is very different from Vice City.
Autor kaže da se automobili voze drugačije nego ranije i da treba vremena da se igrač navikne.
The author says that cars drive differently than before and that it takes time for the player to get used to it.
Popravak oštećenog automobila sada košta novac.
Repairing a damaged car now costs money.
Spori početak možda neće svima odgovarati, ali autor misli da će odnos Jasona i Lucije nositi cijelu priču.
The slow start might not suit everyone, but the author thinks the relationship of Jason and Lucia will carry the whole story.

title: Instagram sada dozvoljava uređivanje storyja nakon objave
Instagram now allows editing a story after posting
body: Korisnici Instagrama sada mogu urediti story nakon što ga objave.
Instagram users can now edit a story after they post it.
Promjenu je potvrdio Adam Mosseri, šef Instagrama.
The change was confirmed by Adam Mosseri, the head of Instagram.
Do sada je jedini način da se ispravi greška bio da se story obriše i ponovo objavi.
Until now the only way to fix a mistake was to delete the story and post it again.
Tako su korisnici gubili i sve preglede koje je story već imao.
That way users also lost all the views the story already had.
Sada mogu dodati naljepnice i crteže, ispraviti tekst ili promijeniti muziku.
Now they can add stickers and drawings, fix the text or change the music.
Uređivanje je moguće samo u prvih 15 minuta nakon objave.
Editing is possible only in the first 15 minutes after posting.
Treba kliknuti na tri tačke na dnu ekrana i izabrati opciju za uređivanje.
You need to tap the three dots at the bottom of the screen and choose the editing option.
Isto ograničenje od 15 minuta Instagram je u aprilu uveo i za uređivanje komentara.
Instagram introduced the same 15-minute limit for editing comments in April.
Ove godine korisnici su dobili i mogućnost da mijenjaju redoslijed fotografija nakon objave.
This year users also got the option to change the order of photos after posting.
Još nije jasno da li je nova opcija već dostupna svim korisnicima.
It is not yet clear whether the new option is already available to all users.

title: Kritičari podijeljeni o novom filmu iz serijala Igre gladi
Critics divided about the new film in the Hunger Games series
body: Novi film „The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping“ podijelio je filmske kritičare.
The new film "The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping" has divided film critics.
Prve kritike objavljene su u utorak, a na stranici Rotten Tomatoes film ima 76 posto pozitivnih ocjena.
The first reviews were published on Tuesday, and on the Rotten Tomatoes website the film has 76 percent positive ratings.
U kina u SAD-u stiže u petak, 20. novembra.
It comes to cinemas in the US on Friday, 20 November.
Film je režirao Francis Lawrence, a priča se dešava 24 godine prije prvog filma.
The film was directed by Francis Lawrence, and the story takes place 24 years before the first film.
Glavni lik je 16-godišnji Haymitch Abernathy, kojeg igra mladi glumac Joseph Zada.
The main character is 16-year-old Haymitch Abernathy, who is played by young actor Joseph Zada.
Kritičar The Hollywood Reportera napisao je da će ova uloga od Zade napraviti zvijezdu.
The critic of The Hollywood Reporter wrote that this role will make Zada a star.
Time Out je filmu dao četiri zvjezdice, ali kaže da je predug jer traje dva i po sata.
Time Out gave the film four stars, but says it is too long because it lasts two and a half hours.
Peter Bradshaw iz Guardiana dao je samo jednu zvjezdicu i napisao da film nema pravi razlog da postoji.
Peter Bradshaw from the Guardian gave only one star and wrote that the film has no real reason to exist.
Kritičar Varietyja misli da problemi dolaze iz knjige Suzanne Collins.
Variety's critic thinks the problems come from Suzanne Collins's book.
U filmu se vraćaju Jennifer Lawrence, Josh Hutcherson i Woody Harrelson, a predsjednika Snowa igra Ralph Fiennes.
Jennifer Lawrence, Josh Hutcherson and Woody Harrelson return in the film, and President Snow is played by Ralph Fiennes.

title: Poznata su imena svih budućih ministara u Vladi TK
The names of all future ministers in the Tuzla Canton government are known
body: Stranke koje formiraju novu vlast u Tuzlanskom kantonu predložile su kandidate za svih 12 ministarstava.
The parties forming the new government in Tuzla Canton have proposed candidates for all 12 ministries.
Posljednji je svoje kandidate predložio Demokratski front.
The Democratic Front was the last to propose its candidates.
Novu vladu će voditi mandatar Omer Kovčić iz SDA.
The new government will be led by prime minister-designate Omer Kovčić from the SDA.
SDA će imati 7 ministara, Stranka za BiH i Demokratski front po 2, a SBB jednog.
The SDA will have 7 ministers, the Party for BiH and the Democratic Front 2 each, and the SBB one.
Za ministra finansija SDA predlaže Eldina Omića, a za ministra zdravstva Muju Imširovića.
For finance minister the SDA proposes Eldin Omić, and for health minister Mujo Imširović.
Ministarstvo unutrašnjih poslova trebao bi voditi Sejfo Muharemović.
The interior ministry should be led by Sejfo Muharemović.
Samo jedna osoba ostaje iz sadašnje vlade, a to je Nataša Matošević, ministrica pravosuđa i uprave.
Only one person stays from the current government, and that is Nataša Matošević, the minister of justice and administration.
Kovčić će prvo razgovarati sa strankama, a onda će odrediti konačan sastav vlade.
Kovčić will first talk with the parties, and then he will decide the final composition of the government.
Nove ministre na kraju moraju potvrditi zastupnici u kantonalnoj skupštini.
In the end the new ministers must be confirmed by the deputies in the cantonal assembly.
Tek nakon toga nova vlada može početi raditi.
Only after that can the new government start working.

title: Jako nevrijeme u Beogradu, mnoge ulice pod vodom
Heavy storm in Belgrade, many streets under water
body: Snažno nevrijeme s pljuskom, grmljavinom i jakim vjetrom pogodilo je danas poslijepodne Beograd.
A strong storm with a downpour, thunder and strong wind hit Belgrade this afternoon.
Kiša je padala od ranije, ali je oko 14:40 postala mnogo jača.
Rain had been falling since earlier, but at about 14:40 it became much stronger.
Mnoge ulice u centru grada bile su pod vodom.
Many streets in the city centre were under water.
Saobraćaj je skoro dva sata bio veoma otežan, a na glavnim ulicama bile su velike gužve.
Traffic was very difficult for almost two hours, and there were big traffic jams on the main streets.
Ministarstvo unutrašnjih poslova Srbije upozorilo je vozače da budu oprezni.
The Serbian Ministry of the Interior warned drivers to be careful.
Hidrometeorološki zavod Srbije izdao je posebno upozorenje zbog obilne kiše.
Serbia’s Hydrometeorological Institute issued a special warning because of heavy rain.
Upozorenje važi za Beograd, ali i za ostale dijelove Srbije.
The warning applies to Belgrade, but also to other parts of Serbia.
Jaka kiša očekuje se od Bačke i Srema preko zapadne i centralne Srbije do istoka i jugoistoka zemlje.
Heavy rain is expected from Bačka and Srem across western and central Serbia to the east and south-east of the country.
Moglo bi pasti od 30 do 50 milimetara kiše, a negdje i više.
Between 30 and 50 millimetres of rain could fall, and in some places more.
Prema radarskim snimcima, kiša će u Beogradu padati i večeras, u noći na četvrtak.
According to radar images, rain will fall in Belgrade tonight as well, in the night to Thursday.

title: Rumunski mediji pišu o golu Esmira Bajraktarevića
Romanian media write about Esmir Bajraktarević’s goal
body: Bosna i Hercegovina je u utorak navečer u Zenici pobijedila Rumuniju 2:1 u Ligi nacija.
On Tuesday evening in Zenica Bosnia and Herzegovina beat Romania 2:1 in the Nations League.
Pobjednički gol postigao je Esmir Bajraktarević u 82. minuti jakim udarcem iz kaznenog prostora.
The winning goal was scored by Esmir Bajraktarević in the 82nd minute with a strong shot from the penalty area.
Rumunski mediji danas mnogo pišu o tom golu.
Romanian media are writing a lot about that goal today.
Portal Sport.ro nazvao je Bajraktarevića "ubicom Rumunije", a njegov udarac "torpedom".
The website Sport.ro called Bajraktarević "the killer of Romania", and his shot "a torpedo".
Golman Rumunije nije imao nikakvu šansu da odbrani taj udarac.
Romania’s goalkeeper had no chance to save that shot.
Portal Golazo.ro napisao je da je to "déjà vu", jer je Rumunija i prošle godine izgubila od BiH u Zenici.
The website Golazo.ro wrote that it is a "déjà vu", because Romania also lost to BiH in Zenica last year.
Bajraktarević ima 21 godinu, rođen je u SAD-u i igra za PSV.
Bajraktarević is 21 years old, he was born in the USA and plays for PSV.
Rumunski igrač Daniel Bîrligea rekao je da je BiH dala jako lijep gol.
Romanian player Daniel Bîrligea said that BiH scored a very beautiful goal.
Rumunija je završila posljednja u grupi i igrat će baraž za opstanak u Ligi B.
Romania finished last in the group and will play a playoff to stay in League B.
BiH je druga i u petak će saznati protivnika u baražu za ulazak u Ligu A.
BiH is second and on Friday it will find out its opponent in the playoff for entry into League A.

title: Kaki je u sezoni i ima mnogo vitamina A
Persimmon is in season and has a lot of vitamin A
body: Na pijacama i u trgovinama ovih dana ima mnogo kakija, voća koje se zove i japanska jabuka.
There is a lot of persimmon at markets and in shops these days, a fruit that is also called the Japanese apple.
Prema Američkom udruženju za srce, kaki je najbolji od septembra do decembra, kada je sezona većine drugog voća već završila.
According to the American Heart Association, persimmon is best from September to December, when the season of most other fruit has already ended.
Može se jesti svjež, sušen ili u salatama i kolačima.
It can be eaten fresh, dried, or in salads and cakes.
Jedan plod od 168 grama ima oko 118 kalorija i 6 grama vlakana.
One fruit of 168 grams has about 118 calories and 6 grams of fibre.
Daje 55 posto dnevne potrebe za vitaminom A i više od 20 posto potrebe za vitaminom C.
It gives 55 percent of the daily need for vitamin A and more than 20 percent of the need for vitamin C.
Narandžasta boja dolazi od beta-karotena, koji tijelo pretvara u vitamin A, važan za vid i imunitet.
The orange colour comes from beta-carotene, which the body turns into vitamin A, important for vision and immunity.
Vlakna pomažu da se osjećamo siti i usporavaju rast šećera u krvi.
Fibre helps us feel full and slows the rise of sugar in the blood.
Stručnjaci savjetuju da se kaki jede sa zdravom masnoćom, na primjer s orasima ili maslinovim uljem.
Experts advise eating persimmon with a healthy fat, for example with walnuts or olive oil.
Ako se pojede previše, u želucu se rijetko mogu stvoriti tvrde grudve hrane.
If too much is eaten, hard lumps of food can rarely form in the stomach.
Zato treba jesti zrele plodove, dobro ih žvakati i ne pretjerivati.
So one should eat ripe fruit, chew it well and not overdo it.

title: Senatski odbor podržao Johnsona za ambasadora SAD-a u BiH
Senate committee backs Johnson as US ambassador to BiH
body: Odbor za vanjske poslove američkog Senata odobrio je nominaciju Ronalda Johnsona za novog ambasadora SAD-a u Bosni i Hercegovini.
The US Senate Foreign Relations Committee has approved the nomination of Ronald Johnson as the new US ambassador to Bosnia and Herzegovina.
Johnson je penzionisani brigadni general američkih marinaca iz Massachusettsa.
Johnson is a retired brigadier general of the US Marines from Massachusetts.
Sada o njegovoj nominaciji mora glasati cijeli Senat.
Now the whole Senate must vote on his nomination.
Za Johnsona je glasalo 16 članova odbora, a protiv je bilo 5.
16 members of the committee voted for Johnson, and 5 were against.
Podržali su ga i neki demokrati, među njima Jeanne Shaheen, Chris Coons, Tim Kaine i Jacky Rosen.
Some Democrats also supported him, among them Jeanne Shaheen, Chris Coons, Tim Kaine and Jacky Rosen.
Shaheen je na saslušanju u septembru rekla da je u Srebrenici bio genocid i da se mora poštovati teritorijalni integritet BiH.
At the hearing in September Shaheen said that there was genocide in Srebrenica and that the territorial integrity of BiH must be respected.
Johnson je tada rekao da BiH ima složene probleme, ali da je spreman da ih rješava odlučno i razborito.
