Johnson said then that BiH has complex problems, but that he is ready to deal with them decisively and prudently.
Bijela kuća je nominaciju poslala Senatu 1. juna, a Predsjedništvo BiH ju je prihvatilo u augustu.
The White House sent the nomination to the Senate on 1 June, and the Presidency of BiH accepted it in August.
Datum glasanja u Senatu još nije poznat.
The date of the vote in the Senate is not yet known.
Ako ga Senat potvrdi, predsjednik Donald Trump će ga zvanično imenovati.
If the Senate confirms him, President Donald Trump will officially appoint him.
Nakon toga Johnson će doći u Sarajevo i predati akreditive Predsjedništvu BiH, kada počinje njegov mandat.
After that Johnson will come to Sarajevo and present his credentials to the Presidency of BiH, when his term begins.

title: Borut Pahor na putu za Sarajevo pitao policajce za put
Borut Pahor asked police officers for directions on the way to Sarajevo
body: Bivši predsjednik Slovenije Borut Pahor putovao je automobilom u Sarajevo na jednu međunarodnu konferenciju.
The former president of Slovenia Borut Pahor travelled by car to Sarajevo for an international conference.
Na putu je posumnjao da mu GPS ne pokazuje pravi smjer.
On the way he suspected that his GPS was not showing the right direction.
Zato je stao pored ceste i pitao policajce kuda treba ići.
So he stopped by the road and asked police officers where to go.
Pahor je o tome napisao objavu na Instagramu, na slovenskom jeziku.
Pahor wrote a post about it on Instagram, in Slovenian.
Uz tekst je objavio fotografiju na kojoj čovjek pokazuje smjer dvojici policajaca pored ceste.
With the text he posted a photo in which a man shows a direction to two police officers by the road.
Napisao je da su policajci bili ljubazni i da je od njih tražio pomoć jer nije vjerovao GPS-u.
He wrote that the police officers were friendly and that he asked them for help because he did not trust the GPS.
Objavu je završio nasmijanim emotikonom i rečenicom da GPS ipak nije griješio.
He ended the post with a smiling emoji and the sentence that the GPS was not wrong after all.
Pahor nije napisao gdje je fotografija nastala.
Pahor did not write where the photo was taken.
Također nije rekao o kojoj konferenciji u Sarajevu se radi.
He also did not say which conference in Sarajevo it is.
Pahor je bio predsjednik Slovenije od 2012. do 2022. godine.
Pahor was president of Slovenia from 2012 to 2022.

title: Naomi Campbell će kao DJ otvoriti ski sezonu na Jahorini
Naomi Campbell will open the ski season on Jahorina as a DJ
body: Britanska manekenka Naomi Campbell nastupit će 28. novembra na otvorenju zimske sezone na Jahorini.
British model Naomi Campbell will perform on 28 November at the opening of the winter season on Jahorina.
Ona neće biti tamo kao manekenka, nego kao DJ-ica.
She will not be there as a model, but as a DJ.
Događaj organizuju Travel 4Fun i SKI Fenix, a nastupit će i drugi DJ-evi s međunarodne scene.
The event is organised by Travel 4Fun and SKI Fenix, and other DJs from the international scene will also perform.
Campbell je godinama puštala muziku samo za prijatelje.
For years Campbell played music only for friends.
Prvi javni nastup kao DJ imala je u martu 2025. godine.
She had her first public performance as a DJ in March 2025.
Od tada je nastupala na sedmicama mode i zabavama u Dubaiju, Parizu, Münchenu i Azerbejdžanu.
Since then she has performed at fashion weeks and parties in Dubai, Paris, Munich and Azerbaijan.
U septembru 2026. na sedmici mode u Milanu predstavila je svoje muzičko izdanje.
In September 2026 at Milan fashion week she presented her own music release.
Campbell je počela karijeru kao tinejdžerka i postala jedna od najpoznatijih manekenki svih vremena.
Campbell started her career as a teenager and became one of the most famous models of all time.
Radila je s velikim modnim kućama i bila je na naslovnicama važnih magazina.
She worked with big fashion houses and was on the covers of important magazines.
Ulaznice za otvorenje sezone prodaju se preko stranice ulaznica.org.
Tickets for the season opening are sold through the website ulaznica.org.

title: BBC izabrao 20 destinacija za 2027., među njima i Bohinj
BBC picks 20 destinations for 2027, including Bohinj
body: Urednici BBC Travela objavili su listu od 20 mjesta koja vrijedi posjetiti u 2027. godini.
The editors of BBC Travel have published a list of 20 places worth visiting in 2027.
Na listi nisu najpoznatiji gradovi poput New Yorka i Venecije, nego mjesta koja iduće godine nude nešto posebno.
The list does not include the most famous cities like New York and Venice, but places that offer something special next year.
Prema BBC-ju, turisti na tim mjestima mogu pomoći i lokalnim ljudima i prirodi.
According to the BBC, tourists in those places can also help local people and nature.
Prvi na listi je Madagaskar, gdje oko 92 posto sisara ne živi nigdje drugo na svijetu.
First on the list is Madagascar, where about 92 percent of mammals live nowhere else in the world.
Na listi je i slovenski Bohinj, gdje je 2026. otvorena nova biciklistička staza duga 28 kilometara.
Also on the list is Slovenia’s Bohinj, where a new 28-kilometre cycle path was opened in 2026.
Staza povezuje Bled i Bohinjsko jezero, pa turisti sada mogu sigurno voziti bicikl kroz Alpe.
The path connects Bled and Lake Bohinj, so tourists can now ride a bike safely through the Alps.
BBC preporučuje i Sardiniju, koju opisuje kao "Italiju bez gužve".
The BBC also recommends Sardinia, which it describes as "Italy without crowds".
Na listi su i Quebec u Kanadi, Gana, koja slavi 70 godina nezavisnosti, i Almati u Kazahstanu.
Also on the list are Quebec in Canada, Ghana, which celebrates 70 years of independence, and Almaty in Kazakhstan.
U japanskom mjestu Ise-Shima u ljeto 2027. bit će ritual koji se održava samo svakih 20 godina.
In the Japanese place Ise-Shima in summer 2027 there will be a ritual that is held only every 20 years.
Tu je i udaljeno ostrvo Sveta Helena, s oko 4.000 stanovnika i samo jednim letom sedmično.
There is also the remote island of Saint Helena, with about 4,000 inhabitants and only one flight a week.

title: Analiza: BiH ima 46 posto šanse da igra na Euru
Analysis: BiH has a 46 percent chance of playing at the Euro
body: Prema novoj analizi portala Football Meets Data, Bosna i Hercegovina je među 24 reprezentacije koje bi mogle igrati na Euru 2028.
According to a new analysis by the website Football Meets Data, Bosnia and Herzegovina is among the 24 national teams that could play at Euro 2028.
Na prvenstvu će igrati 24 reprezentacije, a BiH je na toj listi 23.
24 national teams will play at the championship, and BiH is 23rd on that list.
Analiza je objavljena 18. novembra.
The analysis was published on 18 November.
Šansa da se BiH plasira na Euro je 46,3 posto.
The chance that BiH qualifies for the Euro is 46.3 percent.
Samo Srbija ima manju šansu na listi, 45,2 posto.
Only Serbia has a smaller chance on the list, 45.2 percent.
Najveće favorite su Engleska i Španija, koje imaju skoro 100 posto šanse.
The biggest favourites are England and Spain, which have almost a 100 percent chance.
Od reprezentacija iz regije najbolja je Hrvatska na 15. mjestu, a Slovenija je 20.
Of the teams from the region the best is Croatia in 15th place, and Slovenia is 20th.
Žrijeb kvalifikacijskih grupa bit će 6. decembra u Belfastu.
The draw for the qualifying groups will be on 6 December in Belfast.
Utakmice će se igrati od marta do novembra 2027. godine u 12 grupa.
The matches will be played from March to November 2027 in 12 groups.
Pobjednici grupa i osam najboljih drugoplasiranih idu direktno na Euro, a ostala mjesta odlučit će baraž u martu 2028.
Group winners and the eight best runners-up go directly to the Euro, and the other places will be decided by a playoff in March 2028.

title: Kako je Robert Pattinson dobio ulogu Jamesa Bonda
How Robert Pattinson got the role of James Bond
body: Robert Pattinson je ulogu Jamesa Bonda dobio nakon audicije sa scenom iz starog filma sa Seanom Conneryjem.
Robert Pattinson got the role of James Bond after an audition with a scene from an old film with Sean Connery.
To piše britanski list Daily Mail.
This is what the British paper Daily Mail writes.
Scena je iz filma "Iz Rusije s ljubavlju" iz 1963. godine, a glumi je svaki kandidat za Bonda.
The scene is from the film "From Russia with Love" from 1963, and every candidate for Bond acts it.
U toj sceni Bond u Istanbulu upoznaje sovjetsku agenticu koja ga pokušava zavesti.
In that scene Bond meets a Soviet agent in Istanbul who tries to seduce him.
Reditelj Denis Villeneuve pozvao je Pattinsona na posljednji test pred kamerom.
Director Denis Villeneuve invited Pattinson to a final test in front of the camera.
Pattinson prvo nije bio na listi, nego je pozvan u zadnji čas, kada producenti nisu mogli odlučiti.
Pattinson was not on the list at first, but was invited at the last minute, when the producers could not decide.
Prema pisanju medija, za audiciju je dobio milion dolara.
According to the media, he received a million dollars for the audition.
Jeff Bezos je potvrdio da je učestvovao u testiranju i da je pet kandidata snimilo po tri scene.
Jeff Bezos confirmed that he took part in the testing and that five candidates filmed three scenes each.
Rekao je da je u Pattinsonu bilo "nešto posebno".
He said that there was "something special" about Pattinson.
Pattinson ima 40 godina, a poznat je po filmovima "Sumrak" i "Batman".
Pattinson is 40 years old, and he is known for the films "Twilight" and "The Batman".
To će biti prvi film o Bondu otkako je Amazon kupio studio MGM.
It will be the first Bond film since Amazon bought the MGM studio.

title: Vučić u skupštini napao poslanika Studentske liste
Vučić attacked a Student List deputy in parliament
body: Aleksandar Vučić danas je na sjednici Skupštine Srbije imao burnu raspravu s poslanikom Zlatkom Kokanovićem.
Aleksandar Vučić today had a heated argument with deputy Zlatko Kokanović at the session of the Serbian Assembly.
Kokanović je poslanik Studentske liste, koja je pobijedila na izborima.
Kokanović is a deputy of the Student List, which won the elections.
Vučić je nakon poraza na izborima sjedio među poslanicima opozicije.
After the defeat in the elections, Vučić sat among the opposition deputies.
Tokom govora Vučić je reagovao na povik iz prvog reda i pitao Kokanovića šta je smiješno.
During his speech Vučić reacted to a shout from the front row and asked Kokanović what was funny.
Prema pisanju medija Mondo i Informer, Kokanović mu je tada poslao poljubac iz klupe.
According to the media outlets Mondo and Informer, Kokanović then sent him a kiss from his bench.
Vučić je rekao da mu ne šalje poljupce i da je to razumio kao seksualno uznemiravanje.
Vučić said that he should not send him kisses and that he understood it as sexual harassment.
Dodao je i da nema ništa protiv ljudi takve orijentacije.
He also added that he has nothing against people of that orientation.
Portal 021.rs piše da je Vučić tokom svog govora treći put direktno govorio o Kokanoviću.
The portal 021.rs writes that during his speech Vučić spoke directly about Kokanović for the third time.
Poslaničku grupu Studentske liste vodi Jovo Bakić.
The Student List's group of deputies is led by Jovo Bakić.
Vučić vodi poslaničku grupu svoje stranke.
Vučić leads his own party's group of deputies.

title: Branko Đurić i Izudin Bajrović u filmu Pisma snova
Branko Đurić and Izudin Bajrović in the film Letters of Dreams
body: Glumci Branko Đurić Đuro i Izudin Bajrović pridružili su se ekipi filma Pisma snova.
Actors Branko Đurić Đuro and Izudin Bajrović have joined the crew of the film Letters of Dreams.
Film režira Haris Dubica, a ekipa sada snima u Švicarskoj.
The film is directed by Haris Dubica, and the crew is now filming in Switzerland.
Jedna od lokacija je grad Luzern, gdje su kamere ovih dana postavljene.
One of the locations is the city of Lucerne, where the cameras have been set up these days.
Na snimanju su bili i Tarik Filipović, Harun Ćehović, Aldin Tucić i Abdulsamed Brahović.
Tarik Filipović, Harun Ćehović, Aldin Tucić and Abdulsamed Brahović were also at the filming.
U filmu igraju i poznati švicarski glumci Beat Schlatter, Yvonne Eisenring i Kurt Spallinger.
Well-known Swiss actors Beat Schlatter, Yvonne Eisenring and Kurt Spallinger also act in the film.
Schlatter je jedno od najpoznatijih imena švicarskog filma.
Schlatter is one of the best-known names of Swiss film.
Ulogu imaju i Nikola Kojo, Džejla Ramović, Vanesa Glođo i mnogi drugi.
Nikola Kojo, Džejla Ramović, Vanesa Glođo and many others also have roles.
Pisma snova je međunarodni projekat i predstavlja se kao prva domaća ljubavna komedija.
Letters of Dreams is an international project and is presented as the first domestic romantic comedy.
Premijera filma očekuje se sljedeće godine.
The film's premiere is expected next year.

title: Pandurević optužila Blanušu da je prevario kandidata SDS-a
Pandurević accused Blanuša of cheating an SDS candidate
body: Aleksandra Pandurević oštro je kritikovala predsjednika SDS-a Branka Blanušu.
Aleksandra Pandurević sharply criticised SDS president Branko Blanuša.
Blanuša ju je prošle sedmice izbacio iz Glavnog odbora stranke.
Blanuša threw her out of the party's Main Board last week.
Ona tvrdi da je Predsjedništvo SDS-a protiv statuta odustalo od Milana Aleksića iz Prnjavora kao kandidata za Dom naroda BiH.
She claims that the SDS Presidency went against the statute when it dropped Milan Aleksić from Prnjavor as a candidate for the House of Peoples of BiH.
Stranka je umjesto Aleksića podržala kandidata Pokreta Sigurna Srpska, odnosno PSS-a.
Instead of Aleksić, the party supported a candidate of the Safe Srpska Movement, or PSS.
Prema njenim riječima, Blanuša je napravio dogovor da PSS dobije to mjesto, a on glasove PSS-a za Vijeće naroda RS.
According to her, Blanuša made a deal that PSS gets that seat, and he gets PSS votes for the RS Council of Peoples.
Rekla je da samo Glavni odbor određuje kandidate i da je on već izabrao Aleksića.
She said that only the Main Board decides on candidates and that it had already chosen Aleksić.
Pandurević je napisala da Blanuša uništava stranku i da ju je uništio više nego Carlos Westendorp i Paddy Ashdown zajedno.
Pandurević wrote that Blanuša is destroying the party and that he has destroyed it more than Carlos Westendorp and Paddy Ashdown together.
Westendorp i Ashdown su bivši visoki predstavnici u BiH.
Westendorp and Ashdown are former High Representatives in BiH.
Ona je pozvala poštene članove SDS-a da se okupe i spase stranku.
She called on honest SDS members to gather and save the party.

title: Poljski mediji zahvaljuju BiH nakon pobjede nad Rumunijom
Polish media thank BiH after the win over Romania
body: Pobjeda Bosne i Hercegovine nad Rumunijom od 2:1 u Zenici obradovala je i Poljake.
The 2:1 win of Bosnia and Herzegovina over Romania in Zenica also made the Poles happy.
Golove za BiH postigli su Benjamin Tahirović i Ermin Bajraktarević.
The goals for BiH were scored by Benjamin Tahirović and Ermin Bajraktarević.
Zbog tog rezultata Poljska je ostala treća u grupi i nije morala igrati baraž za opstanak u Ligi B.
Because of that result Poland stayed third in the group and did not have to play a playoff to stay in League B.
Prije posljednjeg kola Poljska je imala samo jedan bod više od Rumunije.
Before the last round Poland had only one point more than Romania.
Poljaci su u utorak igrali 1:1 sa Švedskom, pa je sve zavisilo od utakmice u Zenici.
The Poles drew 1:1 with Sweden on Tuesday, so everything depended on the match in Zenica.
Švedska je prva s 14 bodova, BiH druga s 11, Poljska treća s 5, a Rumunija zadnja s 3 boda.
Sweden is first with 14 points, BiH second with 11, Poland third with 5, and Romania last with 3 points.
Poljski portal Interia napisao je da je Bosna igrala za njih i da je izbjegnuto najgore.
The Polish portal Interia wrote that Bosnia played for them and that the worst was avoided.
Sličan naslov imao je i Newsmax Polska, a Eurosport Polska je pisao da je Poljska sigurna u Ligi B.
Newsmax Polska had a similar headline, and Eurosport Polska wrote that Poland is safe in League B.
BiH će sada igrati baraž za ulazak u Ligu A.
BiH will now play a playoff to enter League A.

title: Aerodrom Banja Luka izgubio skoro 60.000 putnika ove godine
Banja Luka Airport lost almost 60,000 passengers this year
body: Aerodrom u Banjoj Luci jedini je aerodrom u BiH koji ove godine ima manje putnika nego prošle.
The airport in Banja Luka is the only airport in BiH that has fewer passengers this year than last year.
To pokazuju podaci Direkcije za civilnu avijaciju za period od januara do oktobra.
This is shown by data from the Directorate of Civil Aviation for the period from January to October.
Kroz banjalučki aerodrom prošlo je 359.242 putnika, što je 14,31 posto manje nego prošle godine.
359,242 passengers passed through the Banja Luka airport, which is 14.31 percent less than last year.
Broj polijetanja i slijetanja pao je s 4.184 na 3.713.
The number of takeoffs and landings fell from 4,184 to 3,713.
Najveći rast ima Tuzla, gdje je ove godine bilo 554.939 putnika, skoro duplo više nego prošle.
Tuzla has the biggest growth, where there were 554,939 passengers this year, almost twice as many as last year.
Sarajevo je i dalje najveći aerodrom, s 1.973.069 putnika, a to je 17.532 više nego prošle godine.
Sarajevo is still the biggest airport, with 1,973,069 passengers, which is 17,532 more than last year.
Mostar je imao 67.064 putnika, oko 1.500 više nego godinu ranije.
Mostar had 67,064 passengers, about 1,500 more than a year earlier.
Tokom zime iz Tuzle neće biti letova za Pariz i Göteborg, a kompanija Pegasus je otkazala letove za Istanbul.
During the winter there will be no flights from Tuzla to Paris and Gothenburg, and the company Pegasus has cancelled flights to Istanbul.
Banja Luka će za novogodišnje praznike ponovo imati letove za Tivat.
Banja Luka will again have flights to Tivat for the New Year holidays.
Mostar je potpisao ugovor s kompanijom Sky Alps, pa će od maja 2027. imati letove za Bari, Palermo i Rim.
Mostar has signed a contract with the company Sky Alps, so from May 2027 it will have flights to Bari, Palermo and Rome.

title: Zdravstveni radnici nisu blokirali cestu, pregovori počinju sljedeće sedmice
Health workers did not block the road, talks start next week
body: Zdravstveni radnici u Sarajevu danas su održali protest koji je trajao jedan sat.
Health workers in Sarajevo held a protest today that lasted one hour.
Htjeli su od 12 do 13 sati blokirati cestu kod Skenderije, ali nisu dobili dozvolu.
They wanted to block the road near Skenderija from 12 to 13 o'clock, but they did not get permission.
Kantonalno ministarstvo saobraćaja prvo je odbilo zahtjev, a onda je tražilo još dokumenata.
The cantonal ministry of transport first rejected the request, and then asked for more documents.
Nakon sastanka s ministrom zdravstva Hasanovićem sindikat je rekao da pregovori počinju sljedeće sedmice.
After a meeting with health minister Hasanović, the union said that negotiations start next week.
Radnici traže izmjene kolektivnog ugovora i veće plate za sve grupe poslova.
The workers are asking for changes to the collective agreement and higher salaries for all groups of jobs.
Članovi sindikata već sedam noći spavaju u šatoru ispred zgrade Vlade Kantona Sarajevo.
Union members have already slept for seven nights in a tent in front of the Sarajevo Canton Government building.
Svake noći tamo ostaje 5 do 10 ljudi, a ujutro idu na posao.
Every night 5 to 10 people stay there, and in the morning they go to work.
Predsjednik sindikata Senad Sadiković rekao je da je jedini pravi ugovor onaj za svih oko 5.000 radnika u zdravstvu.
Union president Senad Sadiković said that the only real agreement is the one for all of about 5,000 health workers.
Dodao je da će protesti trajati dok svi radnici ne dobiju ista prava.
He added that the protests will last until all workers get the same rights.
Jasmin Avdović iz pregovaračkog tima očekuje da pregovori počnu najkasnije za 15 dana.
Jasmin Avdović from the negotiating team expects the negotiations to start within 15 days at the latest.

title: Novi program utiša prenos skupštine kada govori Vučić
A new program mutes the parliament broadcast when Vučić speaks
body: U Srbiji se pojavila ekstenzija za Google Chrome koja utiša prenos skupštine dok govori Aleksandar Vučić.
An extension for Google Chrome has appeared in Serbia that mutes the parliament broadcast while Aleksandar Vučić speaks.
Ekstenzija je mali dodatak za internet preglednik.
An extension is a small add-on for an internet browser.
Pojavila se nakon konstitutivne sjednice Skupštine Srbije, na kojoj je Vučić govorio satima.
It appeared after the constitutive session of the Serbian Assembly, at which Vučić spoke for hours.
Program se zove Neleceni, besplatan je i nalazi se na stranici GitHub.
The program is called Neleceni, it is free and it is on the GitHub site.
On čita ime govornika koje se pojavi na slici prenosa na YouTubeu.
It reads the speaker's name that appears in the picture of the broadcast on YouTube.
Kada prepozna ime s liste, isključi zvuk, a kada govori neko drugi, zvuk se vraća.
When it recognises a name from the list, it turns off the sound, and when someone else speaks, the sound comes back.
Na listi je prvo Vučić, ali korisnici mogu dodati i druga imena.
Vučić is on the list at first, but users can add other names too.
Ekstenzija radi na računaru, ali ne radi u aplikaciji YouTube na mobitelu.
The extension works on a computer, but it does not work in the YouTube app on a mobile phone.
Još nije u prodavnici Chrome Web Store, pa se mora instalirati ručno.
It is not yet in the Chrome Web Store, so it has to be installed manually.
Portal Nova.rs piše da korisnici kažu da program radi ono što obećava.
The portal Nova.rs writes that users say the program does what it promises.

title: Voyager 1 je sada jedan svjetlosni dan od Zemlje
Voyager 1 is now one light-day from Earth
body: NASA-ina letjelica Voyager 1 danas je kao prvi predmet koji je napravio čovjek stigla jedan svjetlosni dan daleko od Zemlje.
NASA's spacecraft Voyager 1 today, as the first object made by humans, got one light-day away from Earth.
To znači da svjetlost do nje putuje 24 sata.
That means that light travels to it for 24 hours.
Letjelica je tu granicu prešla u 11:16 po našem vremenu, nakon više od 49 godina leta.
The spacecraft crossed that line at 11:16 our time, after more than 49 years of flight.
Voyager 1 je sada oko 25,9 milijardi kilometara od Zemlje i leti brzinom od oko 61.000 kilometara na sat.
Voyager 1 is now about 25.9 billion kilometres from Earth and flies at a speed of about 61,000 kilometres per hour.
Poruka iz centra u Kaliforniji putuje do letjelice 24 sata, a odgovor stiže za još 24 sata.
A message from the centre in California travels to the spacecraft for 24 hours, and the answer arrives in another 24 hours.
Letjelica je počela sa 470 vati energije, ali svake godine gubi oko 4 vata.
The spacecraft started with 470 watts of energy, but every year it loses about 4 watts.
Zato naučnici polako isključuju instrumente koji nisu neophodni.
That is why scientists are slowly switching off instruments that are not necessary.
Voyager 1 je 2012. godine prva letjelica ušla u međuzvjezdani prostor.
In 2012 Voyager 1 was the first spacecraft to enter interstellar space.
Naučnik NASA-e Jeffrey Hayes rekao je da sada počinje godina proslave pred 50. godišnjicu misije u septembru 2027.
NASA scientist Jeffrey Hayes said that a year of celebration now begins ahead of the mission's 50th anniversary in September 2027.
Voyager 2 bi istu udaljenost trebao dostići 2035. godine.
Voyager 2 should reach the same distance in 2035.

title: Generacija X u srednjim godinama ima lošije zdravlje
Generation X has worse health in middle age
body: Britansko istraživanje pokazuje da ljudi iz generacije X u srednjim godinama imaju lošije zdravlje od starije generacije.
A British study shows that people from Generation X in middle age have worse health than the older generation.
Generacija X su ljudi rođeni od 1965. do 1980. godine.
Generation X are people born from 1965 to 1980.
Naučnici s univerziteta UCL u Londonu pratili su oko 8.000 ljudi rođenih 1970. godine.
Scientists from the UCL university in London followed about 8,000 people born in 1970.
Samo 41 posto njih kaže da im je zdravlje odlično ili vrlo dobro.
Only 41 percent of them say that their health is excellent or very good.
Kod starije generacije u istim godinama taj broj je bio 50 posto.
In the older generation at the same age that number was 50 percent.
Gojaznost ima 32 posto ljudi, a dijabetes 9 posto, što je više nego ranije.
32 percent of people have obesity, and 9 percent diabetes, which is more than before.
Svaka peta osoba ima znakove psihičkih problema, a žene češće nego muškarci.
Every fifth person has signs of mental health problems, and women more often than men.
Najveće razlike su između bogatih i siromašnih.
The biggest differences are between the rich and the poor.
Među najbogatijima 59 posto ima vrlo dobro zdravlje, a među najsiromašnijima samo 24 posto.
Among the richest, 59 percent have very good health, and among the poorest only 24 percent.
Doktorica Vanessa Moulton rekla je da istraživanje pokazuje duboke nejednakosti unutar generacije X.
Doctor Vanessa Moulton said that the research shows deep inequalities within Generation X.

title: Zdravstveni radnici danas blokiraju saobraćaj kod Skenderije
Health workers block traffic near Skenderija today
body: Sindikat radnika u zdravstvu Kantona Sarajevo najavio je za danas blokadu saobraćaja kod Skenderije.
The Union of Health Workers of Sarajevo Canton announced a traffic blockade near Skenderija for today.
Blokada bi trebala trajati od 12 do 13 sati.
The blockade should last from 12:00 to 13:00.
Radnici protestuju jer od kantonalne vlade i ministarstva zdravstva nisu dobili odgovor na svoje zahtjeve.
The workers are protesting because they have not received an answer to their demands from the cantonal government and the health ministry.
Oni traže hitne izmjene kolektivnog ugovora i potpisivanje novog ugovora.
They are asking for urgent changes to the collective agreement and the signing of a new agreement.
Žele i usklađivanje koeficijenata, odnosno brojeva po kojima se računaju plate.
They also want the coefficients harmonised, that is, the numbers by which salaries are calculated.
Od prošle sedmice članovi sindikata spavaju u šatoru u parku preko puta zgrade vlade.
Since last week, union members have been sleeping in a tent in the park across from the government building.
Svake noći u šatoru je 5 do 10 ljudi, a nakon toga idu na posao.
Every night there are 5 to 10 people in the tent, and after that they go to work.
Predsjednik sindikata Senad Sadiković rekao je da nisu očekivali da će toliko noći provesti u šatoru.
Union president Senad Sadiković said they did not expect to spend so many nights in the tent.
Kritikovao je vladu i rekao da su povišice od 1 ili 3 posto premale.
He criticised the government and said that raises of 1 or 3 percent are too small.
Sindikat želi uključiti i druge sindikate u Kantonu.
The union wants to involve other unions in the Canton as well.

title: Kiša u BiH, jugo danas donosi do 20 stepeni
Rain in Bosnia and Herzegovina, south wind brings up to 20 degrees today
body: U srijedu će u Bosni i Hercegovini biti pretežno oblačno, s kišom i pljuskovima.
On Wednesday it will be mostly cloudy in Bosnia and Herzegovina, with rain and showers.
Najviše kiše očekuje se ujutro, prema prognozi Federalnog hidrometeorološkog zavoda.
Most rain is expected in the morning, according to the forecast of the Federal Hydrometeorological Institute.
Prije podne će puhati jako jugo, topao vjetar s juga, a na nekim mjestima i olujno.
Before noon a strong jugo, a warm wind from the south, will blow, and in some places it will be stormy.
Tokom dana kiša će padati lokalno, najviše u Hercegovini i jugozapadnoj Bosni.
During the day rain will fall locally, mostly in Herzegovina and southwestern Bosnia.
Jutarnja temperatura bit će od 10 do 16 stepeni.
The morning temperature will be from 10 to 16 degrees.
Najviša dnevna temperatura kretat će se od 15 do 20 stepeni.
The highest daytime temperature will range from 15 to 20 degrees.
U četvrtak sa zapada stiže nova oblačnost, a kiša će padati uglavnom poslije podne.
On Thursday new clouds will come from the west, and rain will fall mostly in the afternoon.
Poslijepodne će puhati jak zapadni i jugozapadni vjetar.
In the afternoon a strong west and southwest wind will blow.
Ujutro će biti od 6 do 11 stepeni, a tokom dana od 13 do 18 stepeni.
In the morning it will be from 6 to 11 degrees, and during the day from 13 to 18 degrees.
Kiša bi trebala prestati u noći prema petku.
The rain should stop during the night towards Friday.

title: SDS odustao od svog kandidata za Dom naroda u korist PSS-a
SDS gives up its candidate for the House of Peoples in favour of PSS
body: Predsjedništvo SDS-a u utorak navečer odlučilo je da povuče svog kandidata za Dom naroda.
On Tuesday evening, the SDS Presidency decided to withdraw its candidate for the House of Peoples.
To mjesto u Parlamentarnoj skupštini BiH sada bi trebalo pripasti Pokretu Sigurna Srpska, odnosno PSS-u.
That seat in the Parliamentary Assembly of Bosnia and Herzegovina should now go to the Sigurna Srpska movement, or PSS.
Odluku je javno objavio Milan Petrović, poslanik SDS-a u Narodnoj skupštini RS-a.
The decision was made public by Milan Petrović, an SDS member of the RS National Assembly.
Glavni odbor SDS-a je 15. novembra u Istočnoj Ilidži izabrao Milana Aleksića za kandidata.
On 15 November in Istočna Ilidža, the SDS main board chose Milan Aleksić as the candidate.
Aleksić je predsjednik opštinskog odbora SDS-a u Prnjavoru.
Aleksić is the president of the SDS municipal board in Prnjavor.
Petrović je rekao da je volja glavnog odbora sada iznevjerena.
Petrović said that the will of the main board has now been betrayed.
Svoju poruku završio je riječima "Jadna li nam majka".
He ended his message with the words "Jadna li nam majka" ("Poor us").
Narodna skupština RS-a bira pet srpskih delegata u Dom naroda.
The RS National Assembly elects five Serb delegates to the House of Peoples.
Vladajuća koalicija koju vodi SNSD ima 56 od 83 mjesta.
The ruling coalition led by SNSD has 56 of 83 seats.
Ako bude glasala disciplinovano, dobit će četiri delegata, a peti ostaje opoziciji.
If it votes in a disciplined way, it will get four delegates, and the fifth remains for the opposition.
